articles.title: Optimizing watermarks for large language models
articles.abstract: With the rise of large language models (LLMs) and concerns about potential misuse, watermarks for generative LLMs have recently attracted much attention. An important aspect of such watermarks is the trade-off between their identifiability and their impact on the quality of the generated text. This paper introduces a systematic approach to this trade-off in terms of a multi-objective optimization problem. For a large class of robust, efficient watermarks, the associated Pareto optimal solutions are identified and shown to outperform the currently default watermark.
articles.titleCn: 优化大型语言模型中的水印
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的兴起以及对其潜在滥用的担忧，生成型LLMs的水印技术近来备受关注。这类水印的一个重要方面在于其可识别性与对生成文本质量影响之间的权衡。本文针对这一权衡问题，提出了一种基于多目标优化问题的系统化方法。对于一大类鲁棒且高效的水印，本文识别了其相关的帕累托最优解，并证明这些解优于当前默认水印。

articles.title: LiSeCo: Linear Semantic Control for Language Generation
articles.abstract: The prevalence of Large Language Models (LLMs) in critical applications highlights the need for controlled language generation methods that are both computationally efficient and enjoy performance guarantees. To address this need, we use a common model of concept semantics as linearly represented in an LLM's latent space. In particular, we take the view that natural language generation traces a trajectory in this continuous semantic space, realized by the language model's hidden activations. This view permits a control-theoretic treatment of text generation in latent space, in which we propose Linear Semantic Control (LiSeCo), a lightweight, gradient-free intervention that dynamically steers trajectories away from regions corresponding to undesired meanings. In particular, we propose to directly intervene, in an online fashion, the activations of the token that is being generated in embedding space. Crucially, LiSeCo does not simply steer activations towards a desirable region. Instead, it relies on classical techniques from control theory to precisely control activations in a context-dependent way, and guarantees that they are brought into a specific pre-defined region of embedding space that corresponds to allowed semantics. The intervention is computed in closed form according to an optimal controller formulation, minimally impacting generation time. This control of the activations in embedding space allows for fine-grained steering of attributes of the generated sequence. We demonstrate that our approach is effective on different tasks -- toxicity, sentiment, and language (English/Spanish) steering -- while maintaining text quality.

articles.titleCn: LiSeCo：用于语言生成的线性语义控制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在关键应用中的普及凸显了需要计算高效且具备性能保证的受控语言生成方法的需求。为应对这一需求，我们采用一种概念语义的通用模型，该模型在线性表示的LLM潜在空间中呈现。具体而言，我们主张自然语言生成在连续语义空间中描绘轨迹，该轨迹由语言模型的隐藏激活实现。这一观点允许对潜在空间中的文本生成进行控制理论处理，其中我们提出了线性语义控制（LiSeCo），这是一种轻量级、无梯度的干预措施，可动态引导轨迹远离对应于不期望含义的区域。具体来说，我们提出以在线方式直接干预嵌入空间中正在生成的标记的激活。关键在于，LiSeCo不仅将激活引导至期望区域，而是依赖控制理论中的经典技术，以依赖上下文的方式精确控制激活，并保证它们被引入嵌入空间中特定预定义的区域，该区域对应于允许的语义。该干预根据最优控制器公式以封闭形式计算，对生成时间影响最小。嵌入空间中激活的控制允许对生成序列的属性进行细粒度引导。我们证明，我们的方法在不同任务——毒性、情感和语言（英语/西班牙语）引导——上有效，同时保持文本质量。

articles.title: InsurTech innovation using natural language processing
articles.abstract: With the rapid rise of InsurTech, traditional insurance companies are increasingly exploring alternative data sources and advanced technologies to sustain their competitive edge. This paper provides both a conceptual overview and practical case studies of natural language processing (NLP) and its emerging applications within insurance operations, focusing on transforming raw, unstructured text into structured data suitable for actuarial analysis and decision-making. Leveraging real-world alternative data provided by an InsurTech industry partner that enriches traditional insurance data sources, we apply various NLP techniques to demonstrate feature de-biasing, feature compression, and industry classification in the commercial insurance context. These enriched, text-derived insights not only add to and refine traditional rating factors for commercial insurance pricing but also offer novel perspectives for assessing underlying risk by introducing novel industry classification techniques. Through these demonstrations, we show that NLP is not merely a supplementary tool but a foundational element of modern, data-driven insurance analytics.
articles.titleCn: 使用自然语言处理技术的保险科技创新
articles.abstractCn: 随着InsurTech的迅速崛起，传统保险公司正越来越多地探索替代数据源和先进技术，以维持其竞争优势。本文提供了自然语言处理（NLP）及其在保险运营中新兴应用的概念概述和实际案例研究，重点在于将原始、非结构化文本转化为适合精算分析和决策的结构化数据。借助InsurTech行业合作伙伴提供的真实世界替代数据，这些数据丰富了传统保险数据源，我们应用了多种NLP技术，以展示在商业保险环境中进行特征去偏、特征压缩和行业分类。这些基于文本的丰富洞察不仅补充和细化了商业保险定价的传统评级因素，还通过引入新的行业分类技术，为评估潜在风险提供了新视角。通过这些演示，我们表明NLP不仅仅是辅助工具，而是现代数据驱动保险分析的基础要素。

articles.title: VMMU: A Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark
articles.abstract: We introduce VMMU, a Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark designed to evaluate how vision-language models (VLMs) interpret and reason over visual and textual information beyond English. VMMU consists of 2.5k multimodal questions across 7 tasks, covering a diverse range of problem contexts, including STEM problem solving, data interpretation, rule-governed visual reasoning, and abstract visual reasoning. All questions require genuine multimodal integration, rather than reliance on text-only cues or OCR-based shortcuts. We evaluate a diverse set of state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source VLMs on VMMU. Despite strong Vietnamese OCR performance, proprietary models achieve only 66% mean accuracy. Further analysis shows that the primary source of failure is not OCR, but instead multimodal grounding and reasoning over text and visual evidence. Code and data are available at https://vmmu-bench.github.io/
articles.titleCn: VMMU：越南多任务多模态理解和推理基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了VMMU，一个越南语多任务多模态理解和推理基准，旨在评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）如何解释和推理视觉和文本信息，而不仅仅是英语。VMMU包含2.5k个跨7个任务的多模态问题，涵盖了广泛的问题背景，包括STEM问题解决、数据解释、基于规则的视觉推理和抽象视觉推理。所有问题都需要真正的多模态整合，而不是依赖纯文本线索或基于OCR的捷径。我们在VMMU上评估了一系列多样化的最先进的专有和开源VLMs。尽管越南语OCR性能强劲，但专有模型平均准确率仅为66%。进一步分析表明，失败的主要原因不是OCR，而是对文本和视觉证据的多模态基础和推理能力不足。代码和数据可在https://vmmu-bench.github.io/获取。

articles.title: WAInjectBench: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detections for Web Agents
articles.abstract: Multiple prompt injection attacks have been proposed against web agents. At the same time, various methods have been developed to detect general prompt injection attacks, but none have been systematically evaluated for web agents. In this work, we bridge this gap by presenting the first comprehensive benchmark study on detecting prompt injection attacks targeting web agents. We begin by introducing a fine-grained categorization of such attacks based on the threat model. We then construct datasets containing both malicious and benign samples: malicious text segments generated by different attacks, benign text segments from four categories, malicious images produced by attacks, and benign images from two categories. Next, we systematize both text-based and image-based detection methods. Finally, we evaluate their performance across multiple scenarios. Our key findings show that while some detectors can identify attacks that rely on explicit textual instructions or visible image perturbations with moderate to high accuracy, they largely fail against attacks that omit explicit instructions or employ imperceptible perturbations. Our datasets and code are released at: https://github.com/Norrrrrrr-lyn/WAInjectBench.
articles.titleCn: WAInjectBench：用于Web代理提示注入检测的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 针对网络代理，已提出多种提示注入攻击。与此同时，虽然已开发出多种检测通用提示注入攻击的方法，但尚无针对网络代理的系统评估。本研究通过首次提出针对网络代理的提示注入攻击检测的全面基准研究，填补了这一空白。我们首先基于威胁模型，对这类攻击进行了细粒度分类。接着，我们构建了包含恶意样本和良性样本的数据集：由不同攻击生成的恶意文本片段、四个类别的良性文本片段、攻击产生的恶意图像以及两个类别的良性图像。随后，我们系统化了基于文本和基于图像的检测方法。最后，我们在多种场景下评估了它们的性能。我们的主要发现表明，虽然某些检测器能够以中等至较高的准确率识别依赖显式文本指令或可见图像扰动的攻击，但它们在应对省略显式指令或采用难以察觉扰动的攻击时表现不佳。我们的数据集和代码已发布在：https://github.com/Norrrrrrr-lyn/WAInjectBench。

articles.title: RapidUn: Influence-Driven Parameter Reweighting for Efficient Large Language Model Unlearning
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because full retraining is costly, while approximate methods often struggle to remove targeted behaviors without degrading retained utility, especially under limited post-deployment supervision. We consider a practical PEFT setting for targeted behavioral contamination removal with a small forget set, a limited retain buffer, and LoRA-only updates, and propose RapidUn, an influence-guided framework that converts cross-sample influence estimates into fixed sample-specific weights for weighted LoRA unlearning. Across Llama-3-8B on Dolly-15k and Alpaca-57k, with cross-model validation on Mistral-7B + Dolly-15k, RapidUn achieves lower seen-trigger and OOD-trigger-family ASR than Fisher, GA, and LoReUn while maintaining competitive clean utility. On Llama-3-8B + Alpaca-57k, it achieves a 77x wall-clock speedup over the clean-corpus LoRA retraining reference. Complementary TOFU, semantic LLM-judge, and IFEval evaluations further support the effectiveness of influence-guided sample reweighting beyond the controlled trigger benchmark.
articles.titleCn: RapidUn：基于影响驱动的参数重新加权，实现高效大型语言模型去学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的机器卸载仍然具有挑战性，因为完整重新训练成本高昂，而近似方法在有限的后部署监督下，往往难以在不降低保留功能的情况下移除目标行为。我们考虑了一种针对行为污染移除的实用PEFT设置，具有小的遗忘集、有限的保留缓冲区和仅LoRA更新，并提出了一种名为RapidUn的影响引导框架，该框架将跨样本影响估计转换为固定样本特定的权重，用于加权LoRA卸载。在Llama-3-8B上对Dolly-15k和Alpaca-57k进行测试，并在Mistral-7B + Dolly-15k上进行跨模型验证，RapidUn实现了比Fisher、GA和LoReUn更低的已见触发和OOD触发家族ASR，同时保持了具有竞争力的清洁效用。在Llama-3-8B + Alpaca-57k上，它比清洁语料库LoRA重新训练参考实现了77倍的时钟速度提升。互补的TOFU、语义LLM裁判和IFEval评估进一步支持了影响引导样本重新加权在受控触发基准之外的有效性。

articles.title: Self-Improvement as Coherence Optimization: A Theoretical Account
articles.abstract: Can language models improve their accuracy without external supervision? Methods such as debate, bootstrap, and internal coherence maximization achieve this surprising feat, even matching golden finetuning performance. Yet why they work remains theoretically unclear. We show that they can all be understood as coherence optimization, the search for a context-to-behavior mapping that is most compressible and jointly predictable, with debate an exact instance and bootstrap and internal coherence maximization closely related to it. We prove that coherence optimization is equivalent to description-length regularization, and that among all such regularization schemes, coherence regularization with a prior derived from a pretrained model optimizes a lower bound of worst-case accuracy for semi-supervised learning. Our theory, supported by preliminary experiments, explains why feedback-free self-improvement works and predicts when it should succeed or fail.

articles.titleCn: 自我提升作为一致性优化：一种理论解释
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型能否在没有外部监督的情况下提高其准确性？辩论、引导和内部一致性最大化等方法实现了这一惊人的成就，甚至达到了黄金微调性能。然而，它们为何有效在理论上仍不明确。我们表明，它们都可以被理解为一致性优化，即寻找最可压缩且联合可预测的上下文到行为映射，其中辩论是一个精确实例，而引导和内部一致性最大化与之密切相关。我们证明了一致性优化等同于描述长度正则化，并且在所有此类正则化方案中，基于预训练模型导出的先验进行的一致性正则化优化了半监督学习最坏情况准确性的下界。我们的理论，得到初步实验的支持，解释了无反馈自我改进为何有效，并预测了其成功或失败的条件。

articles.title: Med-V1: Small Language Models for Zero-shot and Scalable Biomedical Evidence Attribution
articles.abstract: Assessing whether an article supports an assertion is essential for hallucination detection and claim verification. While large language models (LLMs) have the potential to automate this task, achieving strong performance requires frontier models such as GPT-5 that are prohibitively expensive to deploy at scale. To efficiently perform biomedical evidence attribution, we present Med-V1, a family of small language models with only three billion parameters. Trained on high-quality synthetic data newly developed in this study, Med-V1 substantially outperforms (+27.0% to +71.3%) its base models on five biomedical benchmarks unified into a verification format. Despite its smaller size, Med-V1 performs comparably to frontier LLMs such as GPT-5, along with high-quality explanations for its predictions. We use Med-V1 to conduct a first-of-its-kind use case study that quantifies hallucinations in LLM-generated answers under different citation instructions. Results show that the format instruction strongly affects citation validity and hallucination, with GPT-5 generating more claims but exhibiting hallucination rates similar to GPT-4o. Additionally, we present a second use case showing that Med-V1 can automatically identify high-stakes evidence misattributions in clinical practice guidelines, revealing potentially negative public health impacts that are otherwise challenging to identify at scale. Overall, Med-V1 provides an efficient and accurate lightweight alternative to frontier LLMs for practical, real-world biomedical evidence attribution. Med-V1 is available at https://github.com/NLM-DIR/Med-V1.
articles.titleCn: Med-V1：用于零样本和可扩展生物医学证据归因的小语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 评估文章是否支持某一论断对于幻觉检测和声明验证至关重要。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）有潜力自动化这项任务，但要实现优异性能则需要像GPT-5这样的前沿模型，而这些模型在规模化部署时成本高昂。为了高效进行生物医学证据归因，我们提出了Med-V1，这是一系列参数仅有30亿的小型语言模型。该模型基于本研究新开发的高质量合成数据集进行训练，在五个统一为验证格式的生物医学基准测试中，Med-V1显著优于其基础模型（性能提升达27.0%至71.3%）。尽管规模较小，Med-V1的表现与GPT-5等前沿LLM相当，并能提供高质量的预测解释。我们利用Med-V1开展了首个应用案例研究，量化了在不同引用指令下LLM生成答案中的幻觉现象。结果显示，格式指令对引用有效性和幻觉影响显著，GPT-5生成的声明更多，但其幻觉率与GPT-4o相似。此外，我们还展示了第二个应用案例，证明Med-V1能够自动识别临床实践指南中高风险的证据错误归因，揭示了在其他情况下难以大规模发现潜在的公共卫生负面影响。总体而言，Med-V1为前沿LLM提供了一种高效且准确的轻量级替代方案，适用于实际生物医学证据归因。Med-V1可在https://github.com/NLM-DIR/Med-V1获取。

articles.title: RexDrug: Reliable Multi-Drug Combination Extraction through Reasoning-Enhanced LLMs
articles.abstract: Automated Drug Combination Extraction (DCE) from large-scale biomedical literature is crucial for advancing precision medicine and pharmacological research. However, existing relation extraction methods primarily focus on binary interactions and struggle to model variable-length n-ary drug combinations, where complex compatibility logic and distributed evidence need to be considered. To address these limitations, we propose RexDrug, an end-to-end reasoning-enhanced relation extraction framework for n-ary drug combination extraction based on large language models. RexDrug adopts a two-stage training strategy. First, a multi-agent collaborative mechanism is utilized to automatically generate high-quality expert-like reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning. Second, reinforcement learning with a multi-dimensional reward function specifically tailored for DCE is applied to further refine reasoning quality and extraction accuracy. Extensive experiments on the DrugComb dataset show that RexDrug consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines for n-ary extraction. Additional evaluation on the DDI13 corpus confirms its generalizability to binary drugdrug interaction tasks. Human expert assessment and automatic reasoning metrics further indicates that RexDrug produces coherent medical reasoning while accurately identifying complex therapeutic regimens. These results establish RexDrug as a scalable and reliable solution for complex biomedical relation extraction from unstructured text. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/DUTIR-BioNLP/RexDrug

articles.titleCn: RexDrug：基于推理增强的大型语言模型的可靠多药组合提取
articles.abstractCn: 从大规模生物医学文献中自动提取药物组合（DCE）对于推进精准医学和药理学研究至关重要。然而，现有的关系提取方法主要关注二元交互，难以建模变长n元药物组合，其中需要考虑复杂的兼容性逻辑和分布式证据。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了RexDrug，这是一个基于大型语言模型的端到端推理增强关系提取框架，用于n元药物组合提取。RexDrug采用两阶段训练策略。首先，利用多智能体协作机制自动生成高质量专家式推理轨迹，用于监督微调。其次，应用针对DCE的多维度奖励函数的强化学习，进一步优化推理质量和提取精度。在DrugComb数据集上的大量实验表明，RexDrug在n元提取方面始终优于当前最先进基线。在DDI13语料库上的额外评估证实了其在二元药物-药物交互任务上的泛化能力。人类专家评估和自动推理指标进一步表明，RexDrug在准确识别复杂治疗方案的同时，能够生成连贯的医学推理。这些结果将RexDrug确立为从非结构化文本中提取复杂生物医学关系的一种可扩展且可靠的解决方案。源代码和数据可在https://github.com/DUTIR-BioNLP/RexDrug获取。

articles.title: EnComp: Lightweight Encoder-Only Context Compression for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
articles.abstract: Efficient context compression is critical for retrieval-augmented question answering in resource-constrained settings, where long retrieved contexts increase latency, memory use, and LLM reader cost. We propose a lightweight encoder-only framework for query-driven sentence pruning that preserves answer-critical evidence while aggressively reducing irrelevant context. Our method learns marginal contribution scores for sentences using counterfactual training signals and optimizes a contrastive ranking objective that separates critical evidence from noncritical context. Our approach scores all sentences from a single full-context encoding, enabling fast inference with low computational overhead. Experiments show that it maintains accuracy comparable to the strongest baseline while using 3.7$\times$ less peak memory and achieving nearly 3$\times$ lower compression latency, demonstrating an effective quality--efficiency trade-off for practical resource-constrained deployment.
articles.titleCn: EnComp：轻量级编码器仅上下文压缩，用于检索增强型问答
articles.abstractCn: 在资源受限环境下，高效的上下文压缩对于检索增强型问答至关重要，因为长检索上下文会增加延迟、内存使用和大型语言模型读取成本。我们提出了一种轻量级编码器框架，用于基于查询的句子剪枝，在保留答案关键证据的同时，大幅减少无关上下文。我们的方法利用反事实训练信号学习句子的边际贡献分数，并优化对比排序目标，以区分关键证据和非关键上下文。我们的方法从单个完整上下文编码中为所有句子打分，从而实现低计算开销的快速推理。实验表明，它在保持与最强基线相当准确性的同时，峰值内存使用减少了3.7倍，压缩延迟降低了近3倍，展示了在实际资源受限部署中有效的质量-效率权衡。

articles.title: Causal Tracing of Audio-Text Fusion in Large Audio Language Models
articles.abstract: Despite the strong performance of large audio language models (LALMs) in various tasks, exactly how and where they integrate acoustic features with textual context remains unclear. We adapt causal tracing to investigate the internal information flow of LALMs during audio comprehension. By conducting layer-wise and token-wise analyses across DeSTA, Qwen, and Voxtral, we evaluate the causal effects of individual hidden states. Layer-wise analysis identifies different fusion strategies, from progressive integration in DeSTA to abrupt late-stage fusion in Qwen. Token-wise analysis shows that the final sequence token acts as an informational bottleneck where the network decisively retrieves relevant information from the audio. We also observe an attention-like query mechanism at intermediate token positions that triggers the model to pull task-relevant audio context. These findings provide a clear characterization of when and where multi-modal integration occurs within LALMs.
articles.titleCn: 大型音频语言模型中音频-文本融合的因果追踪
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在各项任务中表现出色，但它们如何以及在哪里将声学特征与文本上下文相结合仍不明确。我们通过因果追踪方法来研究LALMs在音频理解过程中的内部信息流。通过对DeSTA、Qwen和Voxtral进行逐层和逐token分析，我们评估了单个隐藏状态的因果效应。逐层分析揭示了不同的融合策略，从DeSTA中的渐进式融合到Qwen中的突发式后期融合。逐token分析表明，最终序列token充当信息瓶颈，网络在此处决定性地从音频中检索相关信息。我们还观察到中间token位置存在类似注意力的查询机制，该机制触发模型提取与任务相关的音频上下文。这些发现清晰地描述了多模态整合在LALMs中何时以及何地发生。

articles.title: SafeTutors: Benchmarking Pedagogical Safety in AI Tutoring Systems
articles.abstract: Large language models are rapidly being deployed as AI tutors, yet current evaluation paradigms assess problem-solving accuracy and generic safety in isolation, failing to capture whether a model is simultaneously pedagogically effective and safe across student-tutor interaction. We argue that tutoring safety is fundamentally different from conventional LLM safety: the primary risk is not toxic content but the quiet erosion of learning through answer over-disclosure, misconception reinforcement, and the abdication of scaffolding. To systematically study this failure mode, we introduce SafeTutors, a benchmark that jointly evaluates safety and pedagogy across mathematics, physics, and chemistry. SafeTutors is organized around a theoretically grounded risk taxonomy comprising 11 harm dimensions and 48 sub-risks drawn from learning-science literature. We uncover that all models show broad harm; scale doesn't reliably help; and multi-turn dialogue worsens behavior, with pedagogical failures rising from 17.7% to 77.8%. Harms also vary by subject, so mitigations must be discipline-aware, and single-turn "safe/helpful" results can mask systematic tutor failure over extended interaction.
articles.titleCn: SafeTutors：人工智能辅导系统中教学安全基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正迅速被部署为AI助教，然而当前的评估范式仅孤立地评估问题解决准确性和通用安全性，未能捕捉模型在师生互动中是否同时具备教学有效性和安全性。我们认为，助教安全与传统LLM安全存在根本区别：主要风险并非毒性内容，而是通过答案过度披露、错误认知强化和支架责任的放弃所导致的悄然学习侵蚀。为系统研究这种失效模式，我们引入了SafeTutors，这是一个在数学、物理和化学领域联合评估安全性和教学效果的基准。SafeTutors围绕一个基于理论的风险分类体系构建，该体系包含从学习科学文献中提取的11个危害维度和48个子风险。我们发现所有模型均表现出广泛危害；规模并不能可靠地改善效果；多轮对话加剧了行为问题，教学失效率从17.7%上升到77.8%。危害还因学科而异，因此缓解措施必须具备学科针对性，且单轮“安全/有用”的结果可能掩盖长期互动中的系统性助教失效。

articles.title: The Truncation Blind Spot: How Decoding Strategies Systematically Exclude Human-Like Token Choices
articles.abstract: Why does machine-generated text remain detectable? We investigate a mechanistic explanation at the decoding stage: standard strategies such as top-$k$ and nucleus sampling restrict generation to high-probability tokens, while human writers routinely choose contextually appropriate words from deeper in the model's probability distribution. Truncation makes a measurable share of these choices unreachable; we call this the \emph{truncation blind spot}. Across five open models and three domains, 8--18\% of human-selected tokens fall outside common truncation boundaries. Linguistic analysis further reveals disproportionate exclusion of content-word tokens. In a benchmark comprising 1.8 million machine generations, classifiers using only predictability and lexical diversity achieve mean AUC-ROC near 0.97, with substantial variation across decoding settings and strong transfer across generators. Probability-floor samplers substantially narrow the blind spot, demonstrating that the choice of truncation criterion matters for retaining human-used tokens. Together, these findings characterize a source of human--machine distributional mismatch and motivate decoding methods that preserve contextually appropriate low-probability choices while maintaining generation quality. Code and data are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/human_vs_machine.
articles.titleCn: 截断盲点：解码策略如何系统性地排除了类人标记选择
articles.abstractCn: 为什么机器生成的文本仍然可以被检测到？我们研究了在解码阶段的一种机制性解释：标准策略如top-k采样和核采样将生成限制在高概率的标记上，而人类作者通常会从模型概率分布的更深处选择上下文合适的词语。截断使得一部分这些选择变得无法触及；我们称之为“截断盲区”。在五个开放模型和三个领域中，8--18%的人类选择的标记位于常见的截断边界之外。语言分析进一步揭示了内容词标记的不成比例排除。在一个包含180万次机器生成的基准测试中，仅使用可预测性和词汇多样性的分类器实现了接近0.97的平均AUC-ROC，不同解码设置之间存在显著差异，并且跨生成器具有很强的迁移性。概率地板采样显著缩小了盲区，证明截断标准的选取对于保留人类使用的标记至关重要。综合这些发现，它们描述了人类与机器分布不匹配的一个来源，并推动了在保持生成质量的同时保留上下文合适的低概率选择的解码方法。代码和数据可在https://github.com/EstebanGarces/human_vs_machine获取。

articles.title: Toward Measuring Structural Drift in LLM Communication Loops
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly run in stateful pipelines that assemble each prompt from retrieval, memory, tools, and other agents. Such pipelines drift: information that should shape the next response is dropped, compressed, or misrouted while every component still reports success. Existing diagnostics miss this because they evaluate isolated prompts, responses, or task scores, whereas what decouples is the relation between a prompt and the response it draws. Here we show that treating the prompt to response to next prompt chain as the fundamental unit of analysis makes these relations measurable. We introduce structural communication coherence, quantified by two metrics: communication closure, which asks if what the pipeline returns at one turn matches what it faces next, and normalized conditional action contribution, which measures how much a sent message resolves the subsequent reply. Across 2,171 human to human, 58 human to LLM, and 8 LLM to LLM dialogues, these metrics reveal directional interaction structures; crucially, the measured contribution drops by 87 to 92% when a response is swapped for one from another turn, leaving surrounding prompts untouched. Because this approach requires no labels, healthy reference data, or predefined rules only the raw prompts and responses drift can be defined and measured directly from operational traffic, rather than inferred from eventual task failure. Establishing prospective detection performance is the next step.
articles.titleCn: 面向测量大型语言模型通信循环中的结构漂移
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地运行在状态化管道中，这些管道从检索、记忆、工具和其他智能体中组装每个提示。这样的管道会出现偏差：本应塑造下一个响应的信息被遗漏、压缩或错误路由，而每个组件仍然报告成功。现有的诊断方法无法发现这一问题，因为它们评估的是孤立的提示、响应或任务分数，而真正分离的是提示与其所引出的响应之间的关系。在此，我们表明将提示到响应再到下一个提示的链视为分析的基本单元，使得这些关系变得可衡量。我们引入了结构化通信一致性，通过两个指标进行量化：通信闭合性，它询问管道在一个回合中返回的内容是否与其下一个回合面对的内容相匹配；以及标准化条件行动贡献，它衡量发送的消息对后续回复的解决程度。在2,171次人与人对话、58次人与大型语言模型对话以及8次大型语言模型之间对话中，这些指标揭示了方向性交互结构；关键在于，当将一个响应替换为另一个回合的响应时，测得的贡献会下降87%至92%，而周围的提示保持不变。由于这种方法无需标签、健康参考数据或预定义规则，因此原始提示和响应的偏差可以直接从运行流量中定义和测量，而不是从最终任务失败中推断。建立前瞻性检测性能是下一步。

articles.title: Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts
articles.abstract: Deliberative multi-agent systems allow agents to exchange messages and revise beliefs over time. While this interaction is meant to improve performance, it can also create dangerous conformity effects: agreement, confidence, prestige, or majority size may be treated as if they were evidence, producing high-confidence convergence to false conclusions. To address this, we introduce PBRC (Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts), a protocol-level mechanism that strictly separates open communication from admissible epistemic change. A PBRC contract publicly fixes first-order evidence triggers, admissible revision operators, a priority rule, and a fallback policy. A non-fallback step is accepted only when it cites a preregistered trigger and provides a nonempty witness set of externally validated evidence tokens. This ensures that every substantive belief change is both enforceable by a router and auditable after the fact. In this paper, (a) we prove that under evidential contracts with conservative fallback, social-only rounds cannot increase confidence and cannot generate purely conformity-driven wrong-but-sure cascades. (b) We show that auditable trigger protocols admit evidential PBRC normal forms that preserve belief trajectories and canonicalized audit traces. (c) We demonstrate that sound enforcement yields epistemic accountability: any change of top hypothesis is attributable to a concrete validated witness set. For token-invariant contracts, (d) we prove that enforced trajectories depend only on token-exposure traces; under flooding dissemination, these traces are characterized exactly by truncated reachability, giving tight diameter bounds for universal evidence closure. Finally, we introduce a companion contractual dynamic doxastic logic to specify trace invariants, and provide simulations illustrating cascade suppression, auditability, and robustness-liveness trade-offs.
articles.titleCn: 预先注册的信念修正合约
articles.abstractCn: 协商式多智能体系统允许智能体随时间交换信息并修正信念。虽然这种交互旨在提升性能，但也可能产生危险的从众效应：一致性、置信度、声望或多数规模可能被视为证据，从而产生高置信度的错误结论趋同。为解决此问题，我们引入PBRC（预先注册信念修正合约），这是一种在协议层面严格区分开放通信与可接受认知变化的机制。PBRC合约公开固定了一阶证据触发器、可接受的修正算子、优先规则和后备策略。只有当非后备步骤引用预先注册的触发器并提供一组外部验证的证据标记的非空证人集时，该步骤才会被接受。这确保了每一项实质性信念变化都既能被路由器强制执行，又能事后审计。在本文中，(a)我们证明在具有保守后备策略的证据合约下，仅社交轮次不能增加置信度，也不能产生纯粹由从众驱动但确定无疑的错误级联。(b)我们展示了可审计触发协议允许证据PBRC正规形式，这些正规形式保留了信念轨迹和规范化的审计轨迹。(c)我们证明了可靠的强制执行产生了认知问责制：任何顶级假设的变化都可归因于一个具体的已验证证人集。对于标记不变合约，(d)我们证明了强制执行的轨迹仅取决于标记暴露轨迹；在洪泛传播下，这些轨迹正好由截断可达性特征化，为通用证据闭包提供了紧密的直径界限。最后，我们引入了一种配套的契约动态认知逻辑来指定轨迹不变量，并提供了模拟，展示了级联抑制、可审计性和鲁棒性-活性权衡。

articles.title: HIVE: Hidden-Evidence Verification for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models generate text through iterative denoising, exposing hidden trajectories that may contain reliability signals beyond the final output. We propose HIVE, which compresses trajectory hidden states, selects informative step-layer evidence, and conditions a verifier through continuous prefix embeddings to produce a hallucination score and structured diagnostics. Across two D-LLMs and three QA benchmarks, HIVE outperforms eight established baselines and a verifier-backbone-matched text-only control in all six settings. Relative to text-only verification, hidden-evidence conditioning improves AUROC by 1.73--4.60 points and AUPRC by 1.10--3.62 points, with average gains of 3.15 and 2.28 points, respectively. Ablations, evidence interventions, and cross-dataset transfer further support the complementary value of fine-grained hidden trajectory evidence.
articles.titleCn: HIVE：用于扩散大型语言模型幻觉检测的隐藏证据验证
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型通过迭代去噪生成文本，揭示了可能包含最终输出之外可靠性信号的隐藏轨迹。我们提出了HIVE方法，该方法压缩轨迹隐藏状态，选择信息丰富的步骤层证据，并通过连续前缀嵌入对验证器进行条件化，以生成幻觉分数和结构化诊断。在两个D-LLM和三个QA基准测试中，HIVE在所有六个设置中都优于八个既定基线和一个验证器主干匹配的纯文本控制组。相对于纯文本验证，隐藏证据条件化将AUROC提升了1.73至4.60分，AUPRC提升了1.10至3.62分，平均分别提升了3.15分和2.28分。消融实验、证据干预和跨数据集迁移进一步支持了细粒度隐藏轨迹证据的互补价值。

articles.title: Safeguarding LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Threats via Shadow Memory
articles.abstract: As large language model (LLM)-powered agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex, real-world tasks, they face a growing class of attacks that exploit extended user-agent-environment interactions to pursue malicious objectives improbable in single-turn settings. Such long-horizon threats pose significant risks to the safe deployment of LLM agents in critical domains. In this paper, we present ShadowMem, a novel defensive framework designed to counter a wide range of long-horizon threats. Inspired by the "shadow stack" abstraction in systems security, ShadowMem maintains a dedicated, safety-focused agentic memory that distills and retains safety-critical context across the agent's full execution trajectory, leveraging this shadow memory to proactively assess the risk of pending actions prior to their execution. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that ShadowMem substantially outperforms existing defenses across diverse long-horizon threats in detection accuracy, achieves early-stage detection for the majority of attacks, and introduces only negligible overhead to agent utility. To our best knowledge, ShadowMem represents the first framework to detect and mitigate long-horizon threats using an agentic memory approach, establishing a new paradigm for this critical challenge and opening promising directions for future research. The artifacts are available at https://github.com/ZJUWYH/ShadowMem
articles.titleCn: 通过影子记忆保护大型语言模型代理免受长时程威胁
articles.abstractCn: 随着由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体越来越多地部署以执行复杂、现实世界的任务，它们面临着日益增多的一类攻击，这些攻击利用扩展的用户-智能体-环境交互来追求在单轮设置中不太可能实现的恶意目标。这类长时程威胁对LLM智能体在关键领域的安全部署构成了重大风险。在本文中，我们提出了ShadowMem，一个新颖的防御框架，旨在应对广泛的长时程威胁。受系统安全中“影子栈”抽象的启发，ShadowMem维护一个专门用于安全、专注于智能体的内存，该内存提炼并保留跨智能体完整执行轨迹中的安全关键上下文，利用这个影子内存，在执行待处理动作之前主动评估其风险。广泛的评估表明，ShadowMem在检测精度方面显著优于现有的防御措施，实现了对大多数攻击的早期检测，并且仅给智能体效用带来了微不足道的开销。据我们所知，ShadowMem是首个采用智能体内存方法来检测和缓解长时程威胁的框架，为这一关键挑战建立了一种新范式，并为未来的研究开辟了有希望的途径。相关代码可在https://github.com/ZJUWYH/ShadowMem获取。

articles.title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
articles.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often brittle in fine-grained manipulation, where minor action errors during the critical phases can rapidly escalate into irrecoverable failures. Since existing VLA models rely predominantly on successful demonstrations for training, they lack an explicit awareness of failure during these critical phases. To address this, we propose DreamAvoid, a critical-phase test-time dreaming framework that enables VLA models to anticipate and avoid failures. We also introduce an autonomous boundary learning paradigm to refine the system's understanding of the subtle boundary between success and failure. Specifically, we (1) utilize a Dream Trigger to determine whether the execution has entered a critical phase, (2) sample multiple candidate action chunks from the VLA via an Action Proposer, and (3) employ a Dream Evaluator, jointly trained on mixed data (success, failure, and boundary cases), to "dream" the short-horizon futures corresponding to the candidate actions, evaluate their values, and select the optimal action. We conduct extensive evaluations on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks. The results demonstrate that DreamAvoid can effectively avoid failures, thereby improving the overall task success rate. Across four real-world tasks, DreamAvoid achieves 72.5% success, compared with 48.8% for the base policy and 54.4% for GPC-RANK. Our code is available at https://github.com/XianzheFan/DreamAvoid.
articles.titleCn: DreamAvoid：在VLA策略中避免失败的关键阶段测试时梦境技术
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在细粒度操作中往往较为脆弱，因为在关键阶段出现的微小行动错误会迅速演变成不可恢复的失败。由于现有的VLA模型主要依赖成功演示进行训练，它们在这些关键阶段缺乏对失败的明确意识。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DreamAvoid，一个关键阶段测试时梦境框架，使VLA模型能够预见并避免失败。我们还引入了一种自主边界学习范式，以完善系统对成功与失败之间微妙边界的理解。具体而言，我们（1）利用梦境触发器判断执行是否已进入关键阶段，（2）通过行动提议器从VLA中采样多个候选行动片段，（3）采用梦境评估器，该评估器在混合数据（成功、失败和边界案例）上进行联合训练，以“梦境”候选行动对应的短期未来，评估其价值，并选择最优行动。我们在真实世界操作任务和模拟基准上进行了广泛的评估。结果表明，DreamAvoid能有效避免失败，从而提高整体任务成功率。在四个真实世界任务中，DreamAvoid的成功能率达到72.5%，而基础策略为48.8%，GPC-RANK为54.4%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/XianzheFan/DreamAvoid获取。

articles.title: Judge Circuits Explain Format-Induced Inconsistency in LLM-as-a-Judge
articles.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant paradigm for grading model outputs at scale, yet the same model assigns systematically different scores when its output format changes (e.g., a 1-5 rating vs. a True/False label). Existing diagnoses of these format-induced inconsistencies stop at the input-output level. Using Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP), we causally investigate the internal mechanism in five open-weight instruction-tuned models (Gemma-3, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1) across five judgment tasks. We find that judgments across structured understanding and open-ended preference tasks share a sparse Latent Evaluator sub-graph in the mid-to-late layers; zero-ablating it collapses judgment while damaging knowledge probes substantially less than a random ablation of equal size in architecturally modular models. By structurally decoupling abstract judging from output formatting, we provide a mechanistic account of format-induced inconsistency on the open-weight models we study: a continuous judgment signal computed in the shared trunk is mapped through fragile, format-specific terminal branches. The judgment itself can therefore be read out independently of the requested output format. Our findings imply that benchmark comparisons of judge reliability across formats partly measure the fragile formatting stage, and can understate the quality of the underlying evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 判断电路解释LLM作为裁判时格式引起的矛盾
articles.abstractCn: LLM作为评判者已成为大规模评估模型输出的主导范式，但同一模型在输出格式变化时（例如，1-5评分与真/假标签）会系统性地给出不同分数。现有的关于格式诱导不一致的诊断停留在输入输出层面。通过使用位置感知边缘归因修补（PEAP），我们对五个开放权重指令微调模型（Gemma-3、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1）在五个评判任务中的内部机制进行了因果探究。我们发现，结构化理解和开放式偏好任务中的评判共享一个稀疏的潜在评估子图，位于中后层；将其零归因会导致评判能力下降，但对知识探针的损害远小于同等规模的随机归因对模块化架构模型的损害。通过在结构上解耦抽象评判与输出格式，我们为所研究的开放权重模型中的格式诱导不一致提供了机制性解释：在共享主干中计算的连续评判信号通过脆弱的、格式特定的终端分支进行映射。因此，评判本身可以独立于请求的输出格式进行读取。我们的发现表明，跨格式的评判者可靠性基准比较部分测量了脆弱的格式阶段，并可能低估了底层评估的质量。

articles.title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
articles.abstract: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.
articles.titleCn: 移动健身房：一个用于移动GUI代理研究的可验证和高并行模拟平台
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了MobileGym，一个浏览器托管、轻量级、完全可控的环境，专为日常移动使用设计，旨在实现高保真度的交互，而无需复制专有后端。它实现了两个以往日常应用无法企及的功能：通过基于结构化JSON状态的确定性状态判断实现可验证的结果信号，以及通过低成本并行展开实现可扩展的在线强化学习。完整的环境状态被捕获、配置、分叉和比较为结构化JSON，单个服务器可以托管数百个并行实例，每个实例约需400 MB内存，冷启动时间约3秒。分层状态模型和声明式任务定义框架在规模上保持了状态可编程性和任务创建的实用性，而单一的程序化判断机制则同时提供了确定性评估结果和密集的强化学习奖励。配套的MobileGym-Bench提供了416个参数化任务模板，包括256个测试模板和160个训练模板，涵盖28个应用程序，具有确定性判断器和一个结构化的AnswerSheet协议，避免了自由文本匹配失败。在Sim-to-Real案例研究中，GRPO在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct上的256任务测试集上取得了+12.8个百分点的提升，在59个真实设备信号子集上，真实设备执行保留了95.1%的模拟端训练增益。项目页面：https://mobilegym.github.io。

articles.title: PatchBoard: Schema-Grounded State Mutation for Reliable and Auditable LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
articles.abstract: LLM multi-agent systems often coordinate through natural-language dialogue or loosely structured shared memory, making intermediate state difficult to validate, attribute, and audit. We introduce PatchBoard, a schema-grounded collaboration architecture that replaces inter-agent dialogue with validated JSON Patch mutations over a shared structured state. An Architect agent constructs a task-specific schema and workflow rules, while a deterministic kernel validates each proposed state mutation against schema constraints, role-specific write contracts, and runtime invariants before committing it transactionally. On 630 matched ALFWorld episodes, PatchBoard achieves an 84.6% success rate, compared with 30.8% for LangGraph and 61.6% for Flock, while reducing tokens per successful task to 45.5k, compared with 368.3k and 64.2k, respectively.
articles.titleCn: PatchBoard：基于模式的状态变异，用于可靠且可审计的大型语言模型多智能体协作
articles.abstractCn: LLM多智能体系统通常通过自然语言对话或松散结构的共享内存进行协调，这使得中间状态难以验证、归因和审计。我们引入了PatchBoard，这是一种基于模式协作架构，它用经过验证的JSON Patch突变来取代智能体间的对话，并在共享结构化状态上进行操作。架构智能体构建特定任务的模式和流程规则，而确定性内核在提交事务前，会针对模式约束、角色特定的写入契约以及运行时不变量来验证每个拟议的状态突变。在630个匹配的ALFWorld场景中，PatchBoard实现了84.6%的成功率，相比之下，LangGraph为30.8%，Flock为61.6%；同时将每个成功任务使用的token数减少到45.5k，而LangGraph和Flock分别为368.3k和64.2k。

articles.title: Routing-Aware Expert Calibration for Machine Unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning is increasingly important for large language models, yet unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures remains underexplored. Unlike dense models, MoE architectures employ a router at each layer to assign each token to a sparse subset of experts. In this work, we observe that forget data often activates a small subset of experts disproportionately, while these experts may receive much weaker activation from retain data. This forget--retain routing mismatch can leave forget-critical experts under-regularized during unlearning. To address this, we propose \textbf{TRACE}, Targeted Routing-Aware Calibration of Experts, for MoE unlearning. TRACE first detects forget-critical experts from offline activation statistics, and then calibrates retain regularization by reweighting token-level retain losses so that each selected expert's retain-side activation frequency better matches its forget-side counterpart. Experiments on WMDP and MUSE-BOOKS across multiple MoE LLMs show that TRACE consistently improves the forget-utility trade-off, yielding a 9\% relative utility improvement over the strongest baseline under comparable forgetting quality and the best performance on three out of four MUSE-BOOKS metrics.

articles.titleCn: 专家校准的路径感知机器卸载混合专家语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 机器去学习对于大型语言模型日益重要，然而在专家混合（MoE）架构中的去学习研究仍不充分。与密集模型不同，MoE架构在每个层中使用路由器将每个标记分配给稀疏的专家子集。在这项工作中，我们观察到遗忘数据常常过度激活一小部分专家，而这些专家可能从保留数据中接收到的激活强度要弱得多。这种遗忘—保留路由不匹配可能导致在去学习过程中遗忘关键专家的正规化不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了\textbf{TRACE}，即针对专家的靶向路由感知校准，用于MoE去学习。TRACE首先通过离线激活统计数据检测遗忘关键专家，然后通过重新加权标记级别的保留损失来校准保留正规化，使得每个被选中的专家的保留侧激活频率更好地匹配其遗忘侧的对应部分。在WMDP和MUSE-BOOKS上的多项MoE LLM实验表明，TRACE始终提升了遗忘效用权衡，在可比遗忘质量下比最强基线相对效用提高了9%，并在四项MUSE-BOOKS指标中的三项上取得了最佳性能。

articles.title: Algorithmic Unverifiability of Safety for Fixed and Recursively Self-Improving Systems
articles.abstract: We establish mathematical limits of algorithmic safety verification for Turing-complete self-modifying systems, the class in which recursive self-improvement takes place, both for a fixed system and across its own modification. Statically, no verifier is sound, complete and tractable: over unbounded domains by Rice's and Gödel's theorems, over all finite configurations by Trakhtenbrot's theorem, and over succinctly described finite environments because verifying a policy against an adversary is coNP-complete and synthesising one is PSPACE-complete. Dynamically, we model one step of self-modification as a computable transformation of code and ask whether a safety property survives it. If the transformation depends only on behaviour, this is Rice's theorem one level up; if it reads the code, as self-modification does, the question is no longer semantic, yet the same s-m-n reduction works inside a class of behaviourally identical programs and inherits the halting degree. One step is never harder than the property; persistence along the whole trajectory can be $Π^0_2$-complete. Certification by a total algorithm is possible only for transformations of restricted expressivity, not merely for systems that stop changing. No tower of supervisors helps, and every total supervisor errs on an undecidable set of systems. For effectively pointwise properties, every faithful bounded scheme that certifies on finite behavioural evidence admits evolution traces certified at every stage while the property is violated. What survives is exact: a monitor that raises an alarm on violation semidecides it, and comparison against a frozen reference keeps the full theory.

articles.titleCn: 固定和递归自我改进系统的安全性不可验证性
articles.abstractCn: 我们为图灵完备的自修改系统建立了算法安全验证的数学界限，这类系统是递归自改进发生的范畴，包括固定系统及其自身修改。静态上，没有验证器是可靠的、完备且可行的：在无界域上，由于 Rice 定理和哥德尔定理，在所有有限配置上，由于 Trakhtenbrot 定理，在简洁描述的有限环境中，因为验证策略对抗对手问题是 coNP 完全的，而合成策略是 PSPACE 完全的。动态上，我们将自修改的一步建模为代码的可计算转换，并询问安全属性是否能够存活。如果转换仅依赖于行为，这是 Rice 定理的更高层次；如果它读取代码，如自修改那样，问题就不再是语义的，但在行为相同的程序类中，相同的 s-m-n 还原依然有效，并继承了停机度。一步永远不会比属性更难；在整个轨迹上的持久性可能是 $Π^0_2$-完全的。只有表达性受限的转换才能由全算法进行认证，而不仅仅是停止变化的系统。没有监督者的塔能够帮助，每个全监督者都会在不可判定系统集上出错。对于有效逐点属性，每个在有限行为证据上认证的忠实有界方案都承认在属性被违反的每个阶段都有认证的演化轨迹。存活下来的是精确的：一个在违反时半决定报警的监控器，以及与冻结参考的比较保持完整理论。

articles.title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
articles.abstract: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features via startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. Binary Exit prediction using Logistic Regression attains an F1 of 0.48 with 0.55 recall using all features (excluding embeddings), and an F1 of 0.26 with 0.59 recall using textual descriptors only (including embeddings). Feature analysis indicates that optimized densities of hyping markers such as adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords are associated with higher Exit probability, while excessive statement or name length is associated with lower probability. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for potential application in venture screening. Findings indicate that startup framing can serve as standalone predictor of economic outcomes, in high-information-asymmetry investment environments.
articles.titleCn: 基于文本描述预测初创企业退出——计算语言学框架
articles.abstractCn: 这项研究表明，仅凭文本描述就能预测初创公司早期成功（定义为退出），且无需依赖环境、财务或人力资本变量。研究利用覆盖20年间的7,419家初创公司的风险投资筛选数据集，通过初创公司叙事映射技术隔离文本框架变量，并构建了850个特征。研究评估了数据子集和向量嵌入的统计显著性，随后进行了六种模型的监督机器学习实验。使用逻辑回归进行二元退出预测，在排除嵌入的情况下，所有特征（不包括嵌入）的F1分数为0.48，召回率为0.55；仅使用文本描述（包括嵌入）时，F1分数为0.26，召回率为0.59。特征分析显示，形容词、专业术语和流行词汇等“炒作”标记的优化密度与更高的退出概率相关，而过多的陈述或名称长度则与较低的退出概率相关。研究还引入了可量化的“炒作分数”，可用于风险投资筛选。研究结果表明，初创公司的文本框架可以作为独立的经济结果预测指标，在高信息不对称的投资环境中发挥作用。

articles.title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs
articles.abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language-homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances for seven languages. We evaluate five models including multilingual encoders and instruction-tuned LLMs through progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes proverbs through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture-Specific. Our findings show that overall, adding multilingual training data beyond 50% provides only limited additional improvement, although the best supervision level varies across models and languages. Also, we show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form culture-specific exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the moral/advisory and culture-specific forms of proverb contribute more to instruct tuning LLM overall figurative identification performance. These findings motivate multilingual figurative identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept-level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meanings that are context representative.

articles.titleCn: 智慧与统一：多语言培训在谚语中比喻语言识别中的作用
articles.abstractCn: 尽管多语言方法在隐喻语言识别方面并非新事物，但超越语言同质化训练数据的转变需要对翻译多语言监督贡献的更清晰理解。我们使用七种语言的742个谚语概念和6,787个翻译实例来研究这个问题。我们通过逐步增加多语言监督水平，评估了五种模型，包括多语言编码器和指令微调的大型语言模型。此外，我们引入了一个多维谚语标注框架，通过四种互补的隐喻形式——隐喻、道德/建议、因果关系和文化特定——来表征谚语。我们的研究发现，总体而言，超过50%的多语言训练数据仅提供有限的额外改进，尽管最佳监督水平因模型和语言而异。此外，我们表明结合多样的隐喻形式能产生最强的整体性能。一个显著的发现是，最不频繁的隐喻形式——文化特定——在多语言监督下表现出最大的性能提升。此外，谚语的道德/建议和文化特定形式对指令微调大型语言模型的整体隐喻识别性能贡献更大。这些发现推动多语言隐喻识别超越以隐喻为中心的分类法，转向概念级多维框架，该框架明确模拟了与上下文相关的互补隐喻意义形式。

articles.title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
articles.abstract: We build VectraYX-Vision-1B, a sub-2B Spanish/LATAM cybersecurity vision-language model coupling a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder to a 1.04B-parameter decoder via a two-layer MLP projector, and report a diagnostic negative result: not that visual grounding failed, but why. After repairing five silent fine-tuning defects, grounding on a nine-field extraction gate with a shuffled-image control is 2/9, invariant across every configuration that leaves the encoder alone; 2x2 tiling, the one that changes it, loses a field and gains none. Resolution is not the operative variable: the field read almost perfectly has the highest entropy in the corpus. A linear probe on frozen SigLIP features gives per-glyph recoverability p~0.61, predicting 1.9% against an observed 0.00; tiling nearly doubles recoverability on two fields, yet the end-to-end model gets worse. Transplanting a natively-trained visual tower onto the same frozen decoder and recipe takes that address field from 0.00 to 0.81 exact, on a coarser token budget than the tiling condition that recovered nothing: pretraining regime, not resolution, sets how far the losses reach. A later, separately trained checkpoint adds one positive result: on B8 (34 fields, 16 templates, 2,040 items, dual shuffled-image/best-constant control), 9 fields pass, confirming genuine grounding within trained template-field combinations only. Sharpest new finding: inside a well-trained template, an untrained field returns a near-constant wrong answer independent of the image -- landmark-keyed lookup, not free-text reading. B6/B7 tool identification stays at 0.0 on every checkpoint including this one; we retract an earlier 0.08 tool-id score after finding three harness defects a stronger model would conceal. We release code, all three benchmarks, configs, and all training checkpoints, including the B8 corpus.

articles.titleCn: VectraYX-Vision-1B：一个用于西班牙语/拉丁美洲的亚2B级网络安全愿景-语言模型，具有结构化视觉推理和原生工具使用能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们构建了VectraYX-Vision-1B，一个小于2B参数的西班牙语/拉丁美洲网络安全视觉语言模型，该模型将冻结的SigLIP-so400m编码器通过两层MLP投影器与1.04B参数解码器耦合，并报告了一个诊断性负面结果：不是视觉定位失败，而是原因所在。在修复了五个静默的微调缺陷后，使用九字段提取门控并在打乱图像的控制下进行定位，结果为2/9，且在所有保留编码器的配置中保持不变；2x2平铺，即改变它的方法，丢失了一个字段且未获得任何字段。分辨率不是关键变量：几乎完美读取的字段在语料库中具有最高的熵。对冻结的SigLIP特征的线性探测给出每个字符的可恢复性p~0.61，预测值为1.9%，而观察值为0.00；平铺几乎将两个字段的恢复能力提高了一倍，但端到端模型的性能却变差。将原生训练的视觉塔移植到相同的冻结解码器和配方上，将该字段从0.00精确提升到0.81，使用的token预算比什么都没恢复的平铺条件更粗：是预训练机制，而不是分辨率，决定了损失的深度。一个稍后单独训练的检查点增加了一个正面结果：在B8（34个字段，16个模板，2040个项目，双重打乱图像/最佳常量控制）上，9个字段通过，证实只有在训练的模板-字段组合中才存在真实的定位。最尖锐的新发现：在一个训练良好的模板中，未训练的字段返回一个几乎不变的错误答案，与图像无关——这是基于地标键的查找，而不是自由文本阅读。B6/B7工具识别在包括这个检查点在内的每个检查点上都保持在0.0；在发现三个更强的模型会隐藏的 harness 缺陷后，我们撤回了之前0.08的工具id分数。我们发布了代码、所有三个基准、配置和所有训练检查点，包括B8语料库。

articles.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains $143$ instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-verified Lean formalizations and proofs. Evaluations of leading LLMs reveal that current models remain far from reliably completing the full research pipeline. In particular, autoformalization is the sharpest bottleneck: the best model achieves only $11.5$ on translating natural-language claims into formal theorem statements, compared with $28.6$ Pass@8 when proving human-provided formal statements. Building on \ourbenchmark, we further develop an automated TCS research framework that generates, formalizes, filters, and proves new claims. Of $64$ generated claims, only $6$ ultimately pass expert evaluation and proof verification, indicating that beyond formalization, limited research taste remains another major barrier to autonomous TCS research.
articles.titleCn: FormalTCS：对大型语言模型端到端前沿形式理论计算机科学研究进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化理论计算机科学（TCS）研究方面展现出日益增长的潜力，但现有的基准测试与实际研究环境仍相去甚远。我们引入 \ourbenchmark，这是一个经过专家验证的基准测试，用于评估LLMs在前沿端到端TCS研究中的表现。 \ourbenchmark 包含从2025-2026年发表在STOC、FOCS、SODA和COLT会议上的143个实例，保留了论文特定的定义、假设和证明依赖关系，并配有专家验证的Lean形式化证明。对领先LLMs的评估显示，当前模型仍远未能在完整研究流程中可靠地完成任务。特别是，自动形式化是最大的瓶颈：最佳模型在将自然语言陈述翻译为形式化定理陈述方面的得分仅为11.5，而证明人类提供的正式陈述时，Pass@8得分达到28.6。基于 \ourbenchmark，我们进一步开发了一个自动化TCS研究框架，该框架能够生成、形式化、筛选和证明新陈述。在64个生成的陈述中，仅有6个最终通过专家评估和证明验证，表明除了形式化之外，有限的研究兴趣也是自主TCS研究的主要障碍之一。

articles.title: Memory Is Not Always Needed: Characterizing Conditional Memory in Scientific Reasoning
articles.abstract: Scientific reasoning requires language models to retrieve specialized knowledge and incorporate it reliably into multi-step computation. Conditional memory provides an explicit lookup pathway that complements dense neural representations, but its usefulness is inherently input- and computation-dependent: retrieved information may repair missing scientific associations, yet it may also introduce distracting shortcuts or interfere with reasoning that the base model can already perform correctly. In this work, we systematically investigate when, where, and to what extent conditional memory should participate in scientific reasoning. We characterize the scientific knowledge boundary and controlled interventions on memory-enabled knowledge-circuit nodes. Based on these analyses, we propose a Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router that uses task-specific input proxies available before generation to determine whether memory is activated, which layer-stage nodes receive memory signals, and how strongly these signals contribute. Experiments on biological and chemical reasoning benchmarks, covering two backbone families and six task types, show that memory effects vary substantially across inputs, tasks, and injection locations. Compared with static and activation-rate-matched random routing, our approach more consistently preserves beneficial memory contributions while suppressing memory-induced regressions, establishing selective memory allocation as an important principle for reliable scientific reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 记忆并非总是必需：科学推理中的条件记忆特征
articles.abstractCn: 科学推理需要语言模型能够检索专业知识并将其可靠地整合到多步计算中。条件记忆提供了一个明确的查找路径，以补充密集的神经表示，但其有效性本质上取决于输入和计算：检索到的信息可以修复缺失的科学关联，但也可能引入干扰性的捷径或干扰基础模型已经能够正确执行的推理。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了条件记忆应该在何时、何地以及多大程度上参与科学推理。我们刻画了科学知识边界，并对配备了记忆的知识回路节点进行了受控干预。基于这些分析，我们提出了一种知识边界感知路由器，该路由器利用生成前可用的特定任务输入代理来确定是否激活记忆、哪些层级的节点接收记忆信号以及这些信号如何贡献。在涵盖两个主干系列和六种任务类型的生物和化学推理基准测试中，实验表明记忆效应在不同输入、任务和注入位置之间存在显著差异。与静态和激活率匹配的随机路由相比，我们的方法更一致地保留了有益的记忆贡献，同时抑制了记忆诱导的回归，确立了选择性记忆分配作为可靠科学推理的重要原则。

articles.title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
articles.abstract: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty, but this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. The most informative question may therefore differ from the one most valuable for the downstream decision. We propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, requiring no teacher-side risk computation at deployment. Across three matched Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, ESR reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from 0.0645 to 0.0455 (29.5% relative reduction) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from 0.9123 to 0.9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the distinction persists when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk student control further isolates the contribution of asymmetric severity weighting. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.

articles.titleCn: 超越信息检索：基于严重程度感知的主动医疗对话问题监督
articles.abstractCn: 主动医疗对话需要代理根据不完整的患者信息决定提问内容。现有的信息获取方法通常优先考虑能最大程度降低诊断不确定性的问题，但这一标准忽略了医学诊断的一个重要特性：不同的诊断错误可能带来截然不同的后果。因此，最具有信息量的提问可能与对下游决策最有价值的问题不同。我们提出了预期严重性风险（ESR），这是一种考虑后果的提问监督目标，它通过每个候选问题预期减少的、具有严重性感知的终端风险来评估其价值。由于问题必须在观察到答案之前被选择，ESR使用仅训练集的统计信息对可能的答案进行边缘化处理。然后将其排名提炼成一个仅前缀的语言策略，部署时无需教师端的计算。在DDxPlus上的三个匹配Qwen3-4B训练种子中，ESR将平均高严重性诊断遗漏从0.0645降低到0.0455（相对减少29.5%），同时将平均诊断准确率从0.9123提高到0.9320，而对话中仅需额外提问0.14次。固定预算分析表明，当问题数量受控时，这种差异依然存在，而匹配的预期0/1风险学生控制进一步隔离了非对称严重性权重的贡献。这些结果支持将主动医疗对话从降低不确定性转向考虑后果的证据获取。

articles.title: Towards Expert Financial QA via Self-Improving RAG
articles.abstract: Expert-level financial question answering requires both grounded verification to catch numeric hallucinations and audit trails for regulatory compliance, attributes that standard single-pass RAG systems lack. We take a step toward this goal with Self-Improving RAG, a framework that decomposes document QA into three specialized agents (Retrieval, Reasoning, and Judge) coordinated by an orchestrator with feedback-driven self-correction. When the Judge Agent scores an answer below a dynamic threshold, the system triggers retry with escalated strategies: broader retrieval, more careful prompting, and relaxed acceptance criteria. We evaluate on FinanceBench (SEC filing QA), where Self-Improving RAG achieves 86% oracle-guided accuracy (measuring agreement with gold answers) with a 36.4% Lazarus Rate, recovering nearly 4 in 10 initially incorrect answers through targeted retry. A key finding is that a fixed retrieval pipeline with judge-driven retry achieves strong results without dynamic routing, providing full interpretability. Every decision is logged with confidence scores, enabling the audit trails required for regulated financial applications.

articles.titleCn: 通过自我改进的RAG实现专家级金融问答
articles.abstractCn: 专家级金融问题解答需要具备基于事实的验证能力以捕捉数值幻觉，以及用于监管合规的审计追踪，而标准的单次通过RAG系统缺乏这些属性。我们通过自我改进型RAG框架朝着这一目标迈进，该框架将文档问答分解为三个专门代理（检索、推理和判断），并由一个具有反馈驱动的自我修正能力的协调器进行协调。当判断代理给出的答案评分低于动态阈值时，系统会触发使用升级策略的重试：扩大检索范围、更谨慎的提示以及放宽接受标准。我们在FinanceBench（SEC文件问答）上进行了评估，自我改进型RAG达到了86%的或然引导准确率（衡量与标准答案的一致性），具有36.4%的Lazarus率，通过针对性的重试纠正了近40%最初错误的答案。一个关键发现是，固定检索流程结合判断驱动的重试能够取得优异结果，而无需动态路由，从而提供完全的可解释性。每项决策都附带置信度评分，能够生成监管金融应用所需的审计追踪。

articles.title: RideSkill: A Hierarchical Algorithm for Generalized Ride Sharing with LLM-Driven Automatic Evolution
articles.abstract: Ride-sharing, which allows multiple passengers with different origin-destination (OD) pairs to share a single vehicle, is a challenging operational problem, as it requires orders with different OD pairs to be efficiently bundled and assigned to vehicles under uncertain and varying scenarios. Although multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) solutions have achieved promising performance, they suffer from limited generalization (adapting to different environmental scenarios), low transferability (adapting to different platform objectives), and training difficulties in large-scale systems, such as the curse of dimensionality. Recently, motivated by the scaling of large language models (LLMs), several works have incorporated LLMs into ride-hailing systems, either by employing LLMs directly as decision-making agents or using them for automatic algorithm design. However, none of these approaches support vehicle sharing, which complicates the problem by expanding both the state and action spaces exponentially. Moreover, most of them require frequent LLM calls at inference time, making them infeasible for real-time deployment. To address these issues, we propose RideSkill, a hierarchical method for ride-sharing that leverages LLM-assisted automatic algorithmic design. RideSkill consists of a combiner that assigns appropriate skills to each vehicle from a learned skill repository, enabling adaptive dispatch under varying scenarios and objectives, and a repositioner that sequentially relocates idle vehicles to emerging regions, avoiding conflicts among vehicles. Crucially, the skill repository, combiner, and repositioner are all trained by an LLM-based automatic evolutionary method, eliminating the need for LLM calls during deployment and thus ensuring high real-time performance.
articles.titleCn: RideSkill：一种基于LLM驱动的自动进化通用拼车分层算法
articles.abstractCn: 拼车服务，允许具有不同起点-终点（OD）对的多名乘客共享一辆车，是一个具有挑战性的运营问题，因为它需要在不确定且变化的环境中高效地将具有不同OD对的订单捆绑并分配给车辆。尽管多智能体强化学习（MARL）解决方案已取得良好的性能，但它们存在泛化能力有限（适应不同环境场景）、迁移性低（适应不同平台目标）以及在大规模系统中训练困难（如维度灾难）等问题。最近，受大型语言模型（LLM）规模扩展的启发，一些研究将LLM融入网约车系统，或直接使用LLM作为决策智能体，或利用LLM进行自动算法设计。然而，这些方法都不支持车辆共享，通过指数级扩展状态和动作空间而使问题复杂化。此外，它们大多数在推理时需要频繁调用LLM，使其难以实时部署。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RideSkill，这是一种利用LLM辅助自动算法设计的分层拼车方法。RideSkill由一个组合器和一个重新定位器组成：组合器从学习到的技能库中为每辆车分配适当的技能，以实现在不同场景和目标下的自适应调度；重新定位器则依次将闲置车辆重新定位到新兴区域，避免车辆间的冲突。关键在于，技能库、组合器和重新定位器均通过基于LLM的自动进化方法进行训练，从而在部署过程中无需调用LLM，确保了高实时性能。

articles.title: VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Verifiable rewards improve language models through reliable task-level feedback, but methods based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) apply a sequence-level advantage uniformly across all tokens. This coarse credit assignment reinforces or penalizes entire responses without identifying which local decisions to preserve, reinforce, or revise. Conversely, evidence-conditioned self-distillation provides denser token-level supervision, yet teacher imitation can transfer stylistic artifacts and miscalibrated confidence that destabilize training when misaligned with task success. We introduce VERPO, which converts evidence-conditioned guidance into reward-aligned token-level credit assignment while retaining the outcome objective. VERPO decomposes teacher guidance into an evidence-free reference term and signed, evidence-induced corrections at each token. A stopped controller combines selective acceptance, token-wise localization, and cost-aware scaling by balancing alignment with the local GRPO update direction against Fisher movement cost. Furthermore, we introduce Fisher Evidence Contrast (FEC), which attenuates nuisance shifts along an estimated evidence-presence direction through a regularized projection. Across five scientific reasoning and tool-use tasks, VERPO prevents optimization collapse and consistently achieves the highest multi-task average across model backbones, yielding marked improvements particularly on smaller models over strong baselines. Qualitative diagnostics confirm that token acceptance selectively targets reasoning bottlenecks consistent with local reward alignment and Fisher movement cost.
articles.titleCn: VERPO：验证证据正则化策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励通过可靠的任务级反馈改进语言模型，但基于群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的方法将序列级优势均匀应用于所有标记。这种粗粒度的归因强化或惩罚整个响应，而未能识别应保留、强化或修改的局部决策。相反，证据条件自蒸馏提供更密集的标记级监督，但教师模仿可能传递与任务成功不匹配的风格化伪影和校准不当的置信度，从而破坏训练过程。我们引入VERPO，它将证据条件指导转换为与奖励一致的标记级归因，同时保留结果目标。VERPO将教师指导分解为一个无证据的参考项和每个标记处带符号的证据诱导校正。一个停止控制器通过平衡与局部GRPO更新方向的匹配程度与Fisher运动成本，结合选择性接受、标记级定位和成本感知缩放。此外，我们引入了Fisher证据对比（FEC），它通过正则化投影沿估计的证据存在方向减弱干扰性偏移。在五个科学推理和工具使用任务中，VERPO防止了优化崩溃，并在所有模型主干上始终实现了最高的多任务平均性能，特别是在强基线之上，对较小模型产生了显著改进。定性诊断证实，标记接受选择性地针对与局部奖励一致性和Fisher运动成本相符的推理瓶颈。

articles.title: FRAUDSkill: Structured Frozen-Weight Skill Optimization for Audio Anti-Fraud Detection
articles.abstract: Large audio-language models have shown promise for anti-fraud detection by directly processing speech and reasoning over fraud-related evidence. Their deployment, however, requires predictions to follow a predefined label space and a structured decision protocol consisting of service-scenario identification, fraud detection, and conditional fraud-type classification. Existing fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches typically encode task knowledge, constraints, and decision rules into model parameters or manually maintained prompts, making them difficult to adapt as fraud patterns and labeling policies evolve. To this end, we propose FRAUDSkill, a structured frozen-weight adaptation framework that leaves the underlying audio-language model unchanged while optimizing an external layer of skill programs, route-specific policies, and decision rules. We further combine structured output control with validation-guided multi-path inference to ensure protocol-compliant predictions. On the TeleAntiFraud benchmark, FRAUDSkill achieves 73.50% Macro-F1, outperforming the shared frozen-model baseline by 31.96% while reducing invalid outputs to 1.94%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that external skill optimization provides an effective and adaptable solution for structured audio anti-fraud detection without modifying the underlying model. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FRAUDSKILL-114514.
articles.titleCn: FRAUDSkill：音频反欺诈检测中的结构化冻结权重技能优化
articles.abstractCn: 大型音语音模型在反欺诈检测方面展现出潜力，通过直接处理语音并对欺诈相关证据进行推理。然而，这些模型的部署需要预测结果遵循预定义的标签空间，并采用包括服务场景识别、欺诈检测和条件欺诈类型分类的结构化决策协议。现有的微调和基于提示的方法通常将任务知识、约束和决策规则编码到模型参数或手动维护的提示中，这使得它们难以适应欺诈模式和标签策略的演变。为此，我们提出了FRAUDSkill，一个结构化的冻结权重适应框架，在不改变底层音语音模型的情况下，优化技能程序、特定路由策略和决策规则的外部层。我们进一步结合结构化输出控制与验证引导的多路径推理，以确保协议合规的预测。在TeleAntiFraud基准测试中，FRAUDSkill达到了73.50%的Macro-F1，比共享冻结模型基线提高了31.96%，同时将无效输出减少到1.94%。大量实验表明，外部技能优化为结构化音频反欺诈检测提供了一种有效且可适应的解决方案，而无需修改底层模型。源代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FRAUDSKILL-114514获取。

articles.title: Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reasoning capabilities by utilizing chain-of-thought (CoT) as a scratchpad for intermediate stages of thinking. However, CoT techniques require explicit supervision on thinking tokens, which requires rich, task-specific data. In this work, we propose Abstract Token Curriculum (ATC), a novel curriculum learning framework that elicits effective continuous intermediate representations without direct supervision or manual scratchpad design. ATC gradually increases problem complexity through a sequence of distributions, training the model to develop internal abstract ``thoughts'' in the continuous representation space. This paper provides both theoretical and experimental evidence for the benefits of ATC and its advantages over previous methods for training continuous thoughts. Theoretically, we show that for learning parity functions with single-layer softmax attention using ATC, attention naturally focuses on the CoT tokens in the context that provide the ``easiest path'' to predicting the next token. Experimentally, we show ATC's effectiveness on graph reachability and arithmetic learning tasks.
articles.titleCn: 学习你的思想：抽象标记课程
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过将思维链（CoT）作为思考中间阶段的草稿纸，实现了卓越的推理能力。然而，CoT技术需要对思维标记进行显式监督，这需要丰富、特定于任务的数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了抽象标记课程（ATC），这是一个新颖的课程学习框架，能够在没有直接监督或手动草稿纸设计的情况下，激发有效的连续中间表示。ATC通过一系列分布逐渐增加问题的复杂性，训练模型在连续表示空间中发展内部的抽象“思考”。本文为ATC的优势及其在训练连续思考方面优于先前方法的益处提供了理论和实验证据。理论上，我们证明了使用ATC学习单层softmax注意力下的奇偶函数时，注意力自然会集中在上下文中提供“最容易路径”来预测下一个标记的CoT标记上。实验上，我们展示了ATC在图可达性和算术学习任务上的有效性。

articles.title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to draw on information from multiple modalities throughout the reasoning process. Yet existing methods often concatenate modality-specific thought tokens in a single sequence, leaving the model to bridge representational differences as it reasons across modalities. We introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that brings these thoughts into a shared latent space for reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into shared thought tokens, trained to preserve the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final answer or action. Because the same context can support multiple valid next steps, we use diffusion to predict the next block of thought tokens from the input and preceding blocks. Jointly training the encoder and diffusion reasoner with shared model weights encourages thought tokens to be both useful for the task and predictable from the available context. At inference, the model generates these tokens without teacher observations. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest evaluated baselines of 7.3% on visual reasoning tasks and 6.1% on robot manipulation tasks.
articles.titleCn: Uni-LaDiR：潜在扩散统一多模态推理
articles.abstractCn: 多模态推理要求模型在整个推理过程中利用来自多种模态的信息。然而，现有方法通常将特定模态的思维标记连接成一个单一序列，迫使模型在跨模态推理时自行弥合表征差异。我们引入了Uni-LaDiR（统一潜在扩散推理器），这是一个将这些思维引入共享潜在空间进行推理的框架。一个统一的编码器将不同模态的教师推理步骤映射到共享的思维标记中，该编码器经过训练以保留后续推理步骤和最终答案或行动所需的信息。由于相同的上下文可以支持多个有效的下一步，我们使用扩散方法从输入和先前的标记块中预测下一个标记块。通过使用共享模型权重联合训练编码器和扩散推理器，鼓励思维标记既对任务有用，又能从可用上下文中预测。在推理时，模型无需教师观察即可生成这些标记。在十一项视觉语言模型（VLM）基准测试和两项视觉语言行动（VLA）套件中，Uni-LaDiR在视觉推理任务上比最强的评估基线相对提升了7.3%，在机器人操作任务上相对提升了6.1%。

articles.title: Per-Aetiology Contrastive Severity Embeddings with Phonological Pseudo-Labelling for Multilingual Dysarthric Speech
articles.abstract: Most multilingual dysarthria-severity systems either train on a single aetiology-language pair or pool heterogeneous aetiologies into one label space. We test that pooling assumption with four matched HuBERT-base contrastive embedding models under a shared backbone, training recipe, corpus registry and held-out evaluation: one mixed-aetiology baseline and three aetiology-specific models for cerebral palsy (CP), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Training combines clinically labelled speech with ordinal pseudo-labels from a training-free phonological profiling method [1], [2]. On speaker-disjoint, leakage-filtered held-out subsets, the per-aetiology models outperform the mixed baseline across all three target aetiologies: CP (macro F1 0.829 vs 0.676, +22.6 % relative), PD (0.715 vs 0.511, +40.0 %) and ALS (0.788 vs 0.596, +32.3 %). On CP, adding 144 SAP and 44 CDSD pseudo-labelled speakers lifts macro F1 from 0.786 to 0.829 over a clinical-only CP model (+4.3 percentage points). Training data span three to seven languages per aetiology. We position this as a controlled comparison of label-space design choices and discuss pseudo-label calibration, split hygiene, and confidence-thresholded deployment as important limitations for future work.
