articles.titleCn: PRISM-VLM：一种用于紧凑型视觉语言模型的 多轴判别基准
articles.abstractCn: 紧凑型视觉语言模型（VLMs）如今正驱动着日益增长的多模态应用。然而，用于比较它们的基准测试继承了以边界为中心的设计：每个模型都被简化为一个单一的准确率数字，这缩小了在饱和套件上的模型间差距，并在更难的测试上迫使模型挤入低分区间。我们引入了PRISM-VLM，一个多轴判别基准，它沿着涵盖反复出现的失效模式（任务质量、行为鲁棒性和能力瓶颈）的七个轴对每个项目进行评分，并将它们组合成一个单一的PScore，项目来自十五个公开基准。在过去的两年中，针对紧凑型VLMs，PScore在项目级配对自助法下比先前的单轴基准更可靠地分离模型对，并揭示了这些基准平均掉的行為差异。即使统计上不可区分的PScore模型，在每轴上的表现也出现了显著差异，特别是在奉承方面，它与单提示准确率几乎正交。我们将发布完整的流程、提示和每项项目的注释。

articles.title: When Parallel Drafter Meets Parallel Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: DSpark-style parallel drafters have made speculative decoding highly effective, yet their draft phase remains serialized on the critical path of every round. Parallel speculative decoding (PSD) overlaps drafting with verification, yet existing methods must guess the accepted prefix and bonus token in advance: a wrong guess reverts the whole batch to serial drafting. We present DPara, a PSD framework that reuses effective parallel drafters yet guarantees backbone--verification overlap in every round, thereby eliminating this probabilistic fallback altogether. While the target verifies, DPara's diffusion backbone precomputes draft representations for every acceptance boundary with the bonus left unspecified; a lightweight autoregressive head then combines the revealed verification outcome with the matching precomputed representation to emit the next round's draft tokens almost instantly---fully parallelizing the dominant backbone forward with verification and leaving only the negligible head cost serial. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B across seven math, coding, and chat benchmarks show that DPara achieves average speedups of $3.21\times$ and $3.52\times$ over autoregressive decoding, surpassing the strongest serial and parallel speculative decoding baselines alike.
articles.titleCn: 当并行绘图器遇见并行推测解码器
articles.abstractCn: 基于DSpark风格的并行草稿生成器已使推测解码变得非常高效，但它们的草稿阶段在每个轮次中仍保持串行化。并行推测解码（PSD）将草稿与验证过程重叠，但现有方法必须预先猜测接受的词缀和奖励标记：错误的猜测会导致整个批次退回到串行草稿。我们提出了DPara，一个PSD框架，它重用了高效的并行草稿生成器，但保证每轮中骨干验证的重叠，从而完全消除了这种概率性回退。当目标进行验证时，DPara的扩散骨干预计算每个接受边界处的草稿表示，奖励标记保持未指定；一个轻量级的自回归头随后将已揭示的验证结果与匹配的预计算表示相结合，几乎即时地发出下一轮的草稿标记——完全并行化了主导骨干前向传播与验证，仅留下可忽略的头成本串行。在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B上进行的七个数学、编程和聊天基准测试表明，DPara比自回归解码平均加速了3.21倍和3.52倍，超越了最强的串行和并行推测解码基线。

articles.title: What Looks Like a Capability Limit in Vision-Language Models Is a Readout Limit
articles.abstract: Benchmarks for vision-language models offer their answer choices in some convention: a letter, a color name, a pixel coordinate. That convention is treated as neutral. We find it is not, and that the limits a benchmark reports can belong to the readout rather than to the model. On 200 COCO photographs, Qwen3-VL-4B picks the correct one of nine locations for a named object 68.5% of the time when the locations are given in English and 20.0% when the same locations are given as pixel coordinates. Chance is 11.1%. The cost arises when the answer options are coordinates; giving the model a coordinate in the question instead costs 3.5 points and is not significant. The gap holds on a 4x4 grid, under 8-bit rather than 4-bit quantization, and in every slice by object size, boundary distance and category. It also decides which model wins. Two models that tie under English names differ by 39 points in one coordinate system and by 54 in the other, in opposite directions. On the color task, three of the four open models capable of the task show the penalty; on photographs, two of three open models do, and so does Gemini, at 11.1 points on parseable answers (p = 1e-4). GPT-4o does not. To ask whether a model reads a coordinate at all, we attach the wrong name to each one and record which the model follows. Color options written as hue angles are followed below chance; a normalized pixel convention is followed at four times chance. This tells apart conventions a model can use from ones it cannot, though it did not predict accuracy on two untried conventions. Five models also name the same color wheel five different ways, so a fixed answer vocabulary is not neutral across models either. Five times during this work we measured a capable model as incapable because our scorer and the model disagreed about what an answer looks like. We report each case. They are the phenomenon in miniature.
articles.titleCn: 在视觉语言模型中，看似能力限制的实际上是读取限制。
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型的基准测试通常以某种约定提供答案选项：字母、颜色名称或像素坐标。这种约定被视为中立。我们发现它并非如此，基准测试报告的限制可能属于读出过程而非模型本身。在200张COCO照片上，当位置以英文给出时，Qwen3-VL-4B能正确选择命名物体所在位置的概率为68.5%，而当位置以像素坐标给出时，这一概率降至20.0%。随机猜测的概率为11.1%。当答案选项为坐标时，成本会出现；在问题中直接给出坐标则会导致3.5分的损失，但并不显著。这种差距在4x4网格、8位量化而非4位量化、以及按物体大小、边界距离和类别的每个切片中都存在。它还决定了哪个模型获胜。在英文命名下打成平手的两个模型，在一个坐标系中相差39分，在另一个坐标系中相差54分，且方向相反。在颜色任务中，四分之三的开放模型能够执行该任务，其中三个显示了惩罚；在照片上，三分之二的开放模型也显示了惩罚，Gemini也是如此，在可解析答案上为11.1分（p = 1e-4）。GPT-4o则没有。为了探究模型是否真的读取坐标，我们给每个坐标附上错误的名称，并记录模型遵循哪个。以色相角表示的颜色选项低于随机猜测；而归一化像素约定则达到了随机猜测的四倍。这能区分模型可以使用和无法使用的约定，尽管它未能预测两个未尝试约定的准确性。在这项工作中，我们五次将一个能够执行任务的模型评估为无法执行，因为我们的评分器与模型对答案形式的理解不一致。我们报告了每个案例。它们是这一现象的缩影。

articles.title: EviStreams: Human-in-the-Loop AI Data Extraction for Systematic Reviews in Medicine
articles.abstract: Systematic reviews underpin clinical guidelines, yet their data-extraction step is a major expert-labor bottleneck bound by a protocolized workflow: two reviewers extract each study independently, an adjudicator resolves disagreements, and the team keeps an auditable record of how every value was produced. Large language models can assist with extraction, but that assistance must fit established review protocols and preserve reproducibility. We present EviStreams, a live, open-source, no-code web platform that puts review teams in control of AI-assisted extraction at three key stages: program design (a structured decomposition approved before any code runs), field specification (typed field definitions calibrated from a pilot), and extracted predictions (reviewer-blinded dual review with adjudication). Working through a form builder, a domain expert defines typed fields rather than prompts, runs extraction over uploaded PDFs, inspects every value alongside the supporting passage it came from, and resolves a reviewer-blinded dual review into an auditable consensus export. An evaluation across four clinical corpora and three frontier model families, released with the system, shows that extraction quality is shaped far more by the field specification than by the choice of model. EviStreams is live at https://evistreams.com/demo and released under Apache-2.0.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations
articles.titleCn: EviStreams：用于医学系统评价的人机交互式人工智能数据提取
articles.abstractCn: 系统评价为临床指南提供支撑，但其数据提取步骤是一个受标准化流程约束的专家劳动瓶颈：两位审稿人独立提取每项研究的数据，仲裁者解决分歧，团队保留每项数据生成的可审计记录。大型语言模型可辅助提取，但必须符合既定评价协议并保持可重复性。我们提出了EviStreams，一个实时、开源、无代码的网页平台，将评价团队置于AI辅助提取的三项关键阶段控制之下：程序设计（在代码运行前获得批准的结构化分解）、字段规范（从试点中校准的类型化字段定义）和提取预测（审稿人盲法双重审查与仲裁）。通过表单构建器，领域专家定义类型化字段而非提示，对上传的PDF进行提取，检查每个值及其来源的支撑段落，并将审稿人盲法双重审查结果转化为可审计的共识导出。系统随附的跨四个临床语料库和三种前沿模型家族的评价显示，提取质量更多地受字段规范的影响而非模型选择。EviStreams已上线于https://evistreams.com/demo，并在Apache-2.0许可下发布。

articles.title: DeltaS: Reading the Gated Linear Attention State for KV Cache Eviction in Streaming Video
articles.abstract: Recent video-language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that interleave linear and full attention layers for efficient long-context processing. While the recurrent state of linear attention remains fixed in size, the KV cache of full attention continues to grow with the video stream, making eviction necessary under a bounded memory budget. The key challenge in streaming is that eviction must occur before the question arrives, so what to retain has to be decided without the question. Existing eviction methods derive token scores from the KV cache itself, using position, attention, or key-value representations, and attention-based scores further require proxy queries or extra computation. Hybrid backbones offer another source of signal. In gated-delta linear attention, the recurrent state is updated by the residual between each input and what can already be retrieved from the state, so its change over a chunk of frames reflects how much new information the chunk brings. We propose DeltaS, a query-agnostic, training-free method that retains video chunks inducing larger normalized state change, or state drift. In a controlled comparison with the budget and retention policy held fixed, state drift outperforms position-, attention-, and key-value-based signals. With a signal costing only 1.9% of the forward pass, DeltaS surpasses the strongest query-agnostic bounded-memory baseline by 2.1 points on average across six long-video benchmarks and by 5.6 points on the longest benchmark. These results suggest that the two memories of hybrid architectures can work cooperatively. Code is available at https://github.com/MaumAI-Company/DeltaS.
articles.titleCn: DeltaS：流媒体视频中基于KV缓存的门控线性注意力状态读取
articles.abstractCn: 近期视频-语言模型越来越多地采用混合架构，这种架构交替使用线性注意力层和全注意力层，以实现高效的长时间程处理。虽然线性注意力的循环状态保持固定大小，但全注意力层的KV缓存会随着视频流不断增长，在有限的内存预算下需要进行淘汰。流式处理中的关键挑战在于淘汰必须在问题到达之前发生，因此必须在问题到达之前决定保留哪些内容。现有的淘汰方法从KV缓存本身推导出标记分数，使用位置、注意力或键值表示，基于注意力的分数还需要代理查询或额外计算。混合主干提供了另一个信号来源。在门控-增量线性注意力中，循环状态通过每个输入与可以从状态中检索到的内容的残差进行更新，因此其在帧块上的变化反映了该帧块带来的新信息量。我们提出了DeltaS，这是一种与查询无关、无需训练的方法，它保留导致更大的归一化状态变化或状态漂移的视频块。在预算和保留策略保持固定的控制比较中，状态漂移优于基于位置、注意力和键值的信号。DeltaS的信号成本仅为前向传递的1.9%，在六个长视频基准测试中平均超越最强的与查询无关的有限内存基线2.1分，在最长基准测试中超越5.6分。这些结果表明，混合架构的两个内存可以协同工作。代码可在https://github.com/MaumAI-Company/DeltaS获取。

articles.title: Uncheatable Eval: Dynamic Compression-Based Evaluation of Language Models
articles.abstract: Modern large language models are pretrained on massive datasets, making it difficult to prevent benchmark data from entering their training sets and undermining the reliability of evaluation results. Reliable evaluation is particularly challenging for base models, whose limited instruction-following ability complicates task-based assessment. We introduce Uncheatable Eval, a dynamic benchmark that regularly collects newly published text to evaluate base language models and reduce the risk of data contamination. Drawing on the relationship between a model's predictive ability and its ability to compress data losslessly, we use compression rate to evaluate how well models predict new text. We evaluate 80 models across 14 text categories, study how compression changes with context length, and examine the correlation between compression rate and zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Our results yield three main findings: (1) compression performance follows a consistent scaling trend with model size; (2) attention-based, hybrid, and recurrent models differ in how their compression performance changes as more context becomes available; and (3) lower compression rates are strongly associated with higher zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Jellyfish042/uncheatable_eval.
articles.titleCn: 防作弊评估：基于动态压缩的语言模型评估
articles.abstractCn: 现代大型语言模型在海量数据集上进行预训练，这使得难以防止基准数据进入其训练集并削弱评估结果的可靠性。对于基础模型而言，可靠的评估尤为困难，因为其有限的指令跟随能力使得基于任务的评估变得复杂。我们引入了Uncheatable Eval，这是一个动态基准测试，定期收集新发布的文本来评估基础语言模型，并降低数据污染的风险。基于模型预测能力与其无损数据压缩能力之间的关系，我们使用压缩率来评估模型预测新文本的效果。我们对80个模型在14个文本类别中进行了评估，研究了压缩率如何随上下文长度的变化而变化，并检验了压缩率与零样本MMLU准确率之间的相关性。我们的结果得出三个主要发现：(1) 压缩性能随着模型规模的增加而呈现一致的缩放趋势；(2) 基于注意力、混合和循环的模型在更多上下文可用时其压缩性能的变化方式存在差异；(3) 较低的压缩率与较高的零样本MMLU准确率密切相关。代码可在 https://github.com/Jellyfish042/uncheatable_eval 获取。

articles.title: ProCredit: From Outcome Rewards to Progress Credit in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require an agent to modify an environment through a sequence of tool calls, with success determined by the final state. The standard recipe assigns a single outcome reward at the end and compares trajectories sampled for the same task. As a result, a group with no successful trajectory yields no training signal, failed attempts cannot be told apart by how close they came to completion, and turns that advance the task receive the same credit as turns that only query the environment. Prior work refines the unit of comparison from the trajectory to the step, or trains a reward model to supply intermediate signal: the former still derives its signal from final success alone, and the latter estimates it with a model. We observe that the acceptance checks that decide success can also be run on intermediate states, so progress is as verifiable as the outcome. We propose ProCredit, which turns this verified progress into credit: it reruns the acceptance checks after each turn, rewards the turn by its change in progress, and uses these rewards to assign credit both across attempts at the same task and across the turns within a trajectory. Starting from Qwen3.5 base models at three scales on AppWorld, ProCredit outperforms outcome-reward baselines and progress-based baselines in task completion rate at every scale on both test sets, exceeding the strongest outcome-reward baseline by 4.1 percentage points at 4B, and results in a second environment show the same direction of improvement. Ablations show that adding the final progress to the trajectory score alone does not improve performance: the gain comes from crediting progress to the turn where it occurs.
articles.titleCn: ProCredit：从结果奖励到进度信用在代理强化学习中的转变
articles.abstractCn: 长时程代理任务要求代理通过一系列工具调用修改环境，其成功与否取决于最终状态。标准方法在任务结束时分配单一结果奖励，并比较针对同一任务采样的轨迹。因此，没有成功轨迹的组别无法产生训练信号，失败尝试无法根据其接近完成的程度进行区分，而推进任务的步骤与仅查询环境的步骤获得相同的信用。先前工作将比较单位从轨迹细化到步骤，或训练奖励模型以提供中间信号：前者仍仅从最终成功中获取信号，后者则通过模型进行估计。我们观察到，决定成功的接受检查也可以在中间状态上运行，因此进展的验证性与结果一样可靠。我们提出了ProCredit，将这种验证进展转化为信用：它在每一步之后重新运行接受检查，根据步骤进展的变化奖励该步骤，并使用这些奖励在相同任务的多次尝试之间以及轨迹内的各步骤之间分配信用。在AppWorld上从三个尺度的Qwen3.5基础模型开始，ProCredit在两个测试集上每个尺度的任务完成率均优于结果奖励基线和基于进展的基线，在4B尺度上超过最强的结果奖励基线4.1个百分点，并在第二个环境中的结果也显示出相同方向的改进。消融实验表明，仅将最终进展添加到轨迹分数中并不能提高性能：收益来自于将进展信用分配给发生进展的步骤。

articles.title: ThaiTrees: Thai Syntactic Dependency Trees Across Domains
articles.abstract: Studying syntactic patterns in naturally occurring language requires a large parsed corpus, but manual annotation is costly and difficult to scale. Thai has a manually annotated dependency treebank for training and evaluating parsers, but lacks a large automatically parsed corpus for quantitative syntactic research. We present ThaiTrees, a 342M-token corpus drawn from news, Wikipedia, spoken transcripts, and social media. We develop a reproducible pipeline for cleaning, processing, and parsing Thai text under the Universal Dependencies framework. The resulting corpus makes grammatical relations searchable and supports the study of syntactic distributions. We release a frequency lexicon and CoNLL-U parses in machine-readable formats suitable for both AI-assisted and conventional programmatic analysis.
articles.titleCn: 泰式依存句法树：跨领域的泰语依存句法树
articles.abstractCn: 研究自然语言中的句法模式需要大量已解析的语料库，但人工标注既昂贵又难以扩展。泰语有一个用于训练和评估解析器的手动标注依存树库，但缺乏用于定量句法研究的自动解析的大型语料库。我们提出了ThaiTrees，这是一个包含342M个词元的语料库，来源包括新闻、维基百科、口语转录文本和社交媒体。我们开发了一个可重复的流程，用于在通用依存框架下清洗、处理和解析泰语文本。生成的语料库使得语法关系可搜索，并支持句法分布的研究。我们发布了一个频率词汇表和适合AI辅助及传统程序化分析的机器可读CoNLL-U解析结果。

articles.title: Does Step Law Transfer to Small-Scale Language Models? An Empirical Recalibration Below 59M Parameters
articles.abstract: Step Law gives power-law formulas for the optimal peak learning rate eta* and batch size B* when pre-training language models. It was calibrated on models between 59M and 1B parameters; the small-model regime N < 59M was never tested empirically by its authors. This regime matters for single-GPU training, interpretability research, educational experiments, and settings where larger models are infeasible on memory or cost grounds. We test whether Step Law transfers to small language models. We consider three outcomes: H1, the original coefficients work directly; H2, the power-law form holds but with different coefficients; and H3, a power law does not describe the optima in this regime. All experiments use a single nanoGPT/TinyStories pipeline with a 2048-token BPE vocabulary, AdamW, and a warmup-cosine schedule. The optimum for each (N, D) cell is extracted from the loss surface L(eta, B) via a local quadratic approximation in log-log coordinates over the smoothed training loss. The final dataset contains 29 unique (N, D) cells and 935 analysis-ready runs. The main refit uses 25 cells (815 runs) in the working range 4 <= D/N <= 600. On the pooled data we accept H2: the functional form is preserved, but the coefficients differ from the original. We obtain eta*(N, D) = 0.0985 N^(-0.508) D^(0.238) (R^2 = 0.834) and B*(D) = 3.6 x 10^(-4) D^(0.931) (R^2 = 0.950). Step Law's structural claim that B* is independent of N is reproduced (p = 0.87), but the growth of B* with D is nearly twice as steep as in the original work. Direct transfer of Step Law systematically overestimates the optimal learning rate: the median ratio eta_SL / eta* is approximately 4.0x, with a range of 2.4x to 6.6x.
articles.titleCn: 步骤法是否适用于小规模语言模型？一项低于5900万参数的经验重新校准研究
articles.abstractCn: 步长法则为预训练语言模型提供了最优峰值学习率eta*和批次大小B*的幂律公式。该法则在参数量介于59M到1B的模型上进行了校准；其作者从未在小于59M参数的小模型范围内进行过实证测试。这一范围对于单GPU训练、可解释性研究、教育实验以及因内存或成本原因无法使用大模型的场景至关重要。我们测试了步长法则是否适用于小语言模型。我们考虑了三种结果：H1，原始系数可直接应用；H2，幂律形式成立但系数不同；以及H3，幂律无法描述这一范围内的最优值。所有实验均使用单个nanoGPT/TinyStories流程，配备2048词元的BPE词汇表、AdamW优化器和warmup-cosine调度。每个(N, D)单元的最优值通过在平滑训练损失的log-log坐标下进行局部二次近似，从损失曲面L(eta, B)中提取。最终数据集包含29个独特的(N, D)单元和935个分析就绪的运行。主要重拟合使用25个单元（815次运行），工作范围为4 <= D/N <= 600。在汇总数据上，我们接受H2：函数形式得以保留，但系数与原始值不同。我们得到eta*(N, D) = 0.0985 N^(-0.508) D^(0.238) (R^2 = 0.834)和B*(D) = 3.6 x 10^(-4) D^(0.931) (R^2 = 0.950)。步长法则关于B*与N无关的结构性主张得到了验证（p = 0.87），但B*随D的增长几乎是原始工作的近两倍陡峭。步长法则的直接迁移系统性地高估了最优学习率：eta_SL / eta*的中位数为约4.0倍，范围为2.4倍至6.6倍。

articles.title: MWE-ECL: Recoverable Long-Range Context Does Not Always Override Local Lexical Priors
articles.abstract: Long-context evaluations often test whether a model can recover distant evidence, but recoverability does not guarantee behavioral influence. We test the prediction that a distant discourse anchor can remain explicitly recoverable yet fail to change the locally preferred reading of a familiar multiword expression; such failures should concentrate when the model's no-anchor default conflicts with the anchor, while prior-correct decisions remain largely preserved. We introduce Multiword Expression Effective Context Length (MWE-ECL), a bilingual diagnostic whose matched anchor-retrieval, no-anchor prior, and interpretation prompts measure explicit recoverability, model-observed defaults, and anchor-conditioned decisions, respectively. Across eight English deployment panels on a shared 0-128K grid, retrieval-control accuracy on prior-conflict items is 0.989-1.000, prior-conflict override spans 0.806-1.000 (0.809-1.000 after conditioning on correct retrieval), and preservation of prior-correct decisions remains 0.977-1.000. A same-call control querying retrieval and interpretation in one prompt reproduces the gap for DeepSeek V4 Pro (1.000 retrieval versus 0.900-0.920 interpretation), showing that separate invocations are not its sole explanation; smaller or absent gaps in the other two models bound its generality. For DeepSeek V4 Flash, separate prompt-fit tests retain perfect retrieval with lower interpretation at 512K and 1M, while foil-consistent cues shift the no-anchor prior far more than retrieval; cross-model cue effects are heterogeneous. A separately reported 10-family Chinese subset shows similar descriptive gaps, but imperfect retrieval for some models prevents an integration-only attribution. MWE-ECL therefore evaluates whether explicitly recoverable distant context changes a competing local semantic decision.
articles.titleCn: MWE-ECL：可恢复的长程上下文并不总是覆盖局部词汇先验
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文评估通常测试模型能否恢复远距离证据，但可恢复性并不保证行为影响。我们检验了这样一个预测：一个远距离的语篇锚点可以保持明确可恢复，却无法改变一个熟悉的多词表达在局部上的首选解读；此类失败应集中出现在模型的无锚点默认值与锚点冲突时，而先验正确的决策则基本得以保留。我们引入了多词表达有效上下文长度（MWE-ECL），这是一种双语诊断工具，其匹配的锚点检索、无锚点先验和解读提示分别测量显式可恢复性、模型观察到的默认值和锚点条件下的决策。在八个共享的0-128K网格上的英语部署面板中，先验冲突项目的检索控制准确率为0.989-1.000，先验冲突覆盖范围为0.806-1.000（在正确检索条件下为0.809-1.000），先验正确决策的保留率为0.977-1.000。一个同一调用控制的查询同时检索和解读在一个提示中，重现了DeepSeek V4 Pro的差距（1.000检索与0.900-0.920解读），表明分开调用并非其唯一解释；其他两个模型中较小的或缺失的差距限制了其普遍性。对于DeepSeek V4 Flash，单独提示适配测试在512K和1M时保持完美检索但解读较低，而干扰一致的线索比检索更能改变无锚点先验；跨模型的线索效应具有异质性。一个单独报告的10家族中文子集显示了类似的描述性差距，但某些模型的检索不完美，阻止了仅通过整合进行归因。因此，MWE-ECL评估了明确可恢复的远距离上下文是否改变了竞争性的局部语义决策。

articles.title: When Context Misleads: In-context Learning with Jurisdiction in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a cornerstone of modern LLM deployment. However, existing ICL post-training methods have a critical blind spot: they excel at extracting patterns from demonstrations while often neglecting context authority, the ability to determine whether contextual information should govern the final answer. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FakeContextBench, which contains pseudoscientific claims across seven domains. Our evaluation of commercial and open-source models shows that large-scale pre-training alone is insufficient for reliable context-authority discrimination. Moreover, prevalent ICL fine-tuning methods can increase susceptibility to misleading context, reducing reality accuracy by up to 14.95 percentage points relative to the base model. To address this trade-off, we propose Jurisdiction In-Context Learning (J-ICL), a post-training framework that incorporates context validation into the training objective. Across four model backbones, J-ICL improves ICLEval by an average of 5.84 percentage points and reality accuracy by 9.20 points over the corresponding base models. It also raises the Reality Rate by an average of 18.09 points relative to MetaICL and Symbol Tuning. These results demonstrate that ICL capability and resistance to deceptive context can be improved together. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/peilin717/FakeContext-Bench.
articles.titleCn: 当语境误导时：大型语言模型中的情境学习与管辖权
articles.abstractCn: 情境学习（ICL）已成为现代大语言模型部署的核心。然而，现有的ICL训练后方法存在一个关键缺陷：它们擅长从示例中提取模式，但往往忽视情境权威性，即判断情境信息是否应主导最终答案的能力。为了评估这一能力，我们引入了FakeContextBench，其中包含七个领域的伪科学主张。我们对商业和开源模型的评估表明，仅靠大规模预训练不足以实现可靠的情境权威性辨别。此外，普遍的ICL微调方法会增加对误导性情境的易感性，与基础模型相比，现实准确率降低了高达14.95个百分点。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了司法权情境学习（J-ICL），这是一个将情境验证纳入训练目标的训练后框架。在四个模型主干上，J-ICL平均使ICLEval提升5.84个百分点，现实准确率较对应基础模型提高9.20个百分点，并且相对于MetaICL和Symbol Tuning，现实率平均提高了18.09个百分点。这些结果表明，ICL能力和抵抗欺骗性情境的能力可以同时提升。该基准可在https://github.com/peilin717/FakeContext-Bench获取。

articles.title: Can Jev Judge Radiology Reports? Evaluating a System One Model for Clinical Factuality
articles.abstract: An AI-generated radiology report can resemble a physician's report while omitting an abnormality, adding an unsupported finding, or reversing its presence. Measuring these factual differences is essential for evaluating report generators. We study Jev, a System One decision model, as a simple, low-cost judge of agreement with physician-written reference reports. Our evaluator checks whether each statement is supported by the other report and combines these judgments in both directions to capture unsupported claims and omissions. A single-question configuration reaches Kendall correlations of 0.573 on RadEvalX and 0.398 on RadEvalExpert with expert error counts, outperforming an open natural language inference judge under matched decomposition and aggregation. One support question per statement retains similar expert agreement to seven while using 43-45% fewer judgment input tokens. At the documented API price, judgments cost under three cents per hundred report pairs, excluding local decomposition. In a separate controlled-error test, Jev detects false negation with an AUROC of 0.977. Local RadMatch achieves stronger agreement on clinically significant errors in both expert datasets and on total errors in the shared RadEvalExpert subset. Finding-count and error-scope analyses show that benchmark agreement reflects report size and error definitions as well as medical error detection. These results support Jev as a practical judgment component for measuring factual differences in generated radiology reports and identify where more elaborate evaluation remains valuable.
articles.titleCn: 杰夫能否评判放射学报告？评估一个用于临床事实性的系统一模型
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能生成的放射学报告可能类似于医师的报告，但在其中遗漏异常情况、添加未经支持的结果或颠倒其存在。测量这些事实差异对于评估报告生成器至关重要。我们研究了Jev，一种系统一决策模型，作为对医师撰写参考报告的简单、低成本的判断依据。我们的评估器检查每项陈述是否得到另一份报告的支持，并将这些判断在两个方向上结合，以捕捉未经支持的主张和遗漏。单问题配置在RadEvalX上达到0.573的肯德尔相关系数，在RadEvalExpert上达到0.398，优于匹配分解和聚合下的开放自然语言推理判断器。每项陈述一个支持问题保留了与专家相似的七级一致性，同时使用了43-45%更少的判断输入令牌。按文档API价格计算，判断成本每百份报告对低于三美分，不包括本地分解。在另一项受控误差测试中，Jev以0.977的AUROC检测到假阴性。本地RadMatch在两个专家数据集的临床显著错误和共享RadEvalExpert子集中的总错误上实现了更强的协议。计数和错误范围分析表明，基准协议反映了报告大小和错误定义，以及医学错误检测。这些结果支持Jev作为实用判断组件，用于测量生成放射学报告中的事实差异，并确定了更复杂的评估仍然有价值的地方。

articles.title: Brain-to-Language Decoding: Tasks, Signals, Methods, Evaluation, Practical Use and Beyond
articles.abstract: Brain-to-language decoding translates neural activity associated with language production, internal speech and perception into linguistic or expressive outputs. It offers a route to restoring communication after speech loss and a means of studying how the brain represents language. Advances in neural recording and representation learning have expanded the field from constrained recognition and acoustic reconstruction to text generation, streaming personalised speech and facial animation. This survey synthesises these developments across invasive and non-invasive measurements, drawing on a search without a lower year limit and source-led updates through September 2026. We connect Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks to the neural populations they engage, the representations available to decoders and the outputs those representations can support. We examine model development, public resources and the evolution of evaluation, and compare published performance and communication costs within their reported protocols. The synthesis identifies complementary routes to progress: phonetic, acoustic and semantic targets preserve different aspects of a message; shared representations support reuse across recording conditions and tasks; and online communication increasingly depends on calibration, feedback and user control alongside decoding accuracy. Shared benchmarks enable algorithmic comparisons, while longitudinal studies reveal the demands of sustained use. We discuss these developments and their remaining limitations, then outline a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language to meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange
articles.titleCn: 脑机语言解码：任务、信号、方法、评估、实际应用及展望
articles.abstractCn: 脑-语言解码技术将语言产生、内部言语和感知相关的神经活动转化为语言或表达输出。它为在失语症后恢复沟通提供了途径，也为研究大脑如何表征语言提供了方法。神经记录和表征学习领域的进步已将研究领域从受限的识别和声学重建扩展到文本生成、个性化语音流和面部动画。本综述综合了侵入性和非侵入性测量中的这些发展，基于无下限年份的搜索和截至2026年9月的来源更新。我们将表达、内部和感知任务与它们所涉及的神经群体、解码器可用的表征以及这些表征所能支持的输出联系起来。我们考察了模型开发、公共资源和评估的演变，并在其报告的协议内比较了已发表的性能和沟通成本。综合分析确定了进步的互补途径：语音、声学和语义目标保留了消息的不同方面；共享表征支持跨记录条件和任务的重复使用；在线沟通越来越依赖于校准、反馈和用户控制，而不仅仅是解码准确性。共享基准促进了算法比较，而纵向研究揭示了持续使用的要求。我们讨论了这些发展和它们剩余的局限性，然后概述了从指令和语言到意义、场景和双向认知交流的前景五级轨迹。

articles.title: FLEET: From Logits Entropy to Enhanced Trajectories in Text Generation
articles.abstract: Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution. However, this memoryless approach is inherently suboptimal: because it lacks awareness of prior generations and their evaluations, it produces an increasing proportion of semantically duplicate answers as more samples are drawn, leading to diminishing returns. To address this limitation, we introduce FLEET, a novel method that integrates a memory mechanism into the generation process. FLEET represents each generation as a sparse trajectory through states whose entropy exceeds a predefined threshold and uses these trajectories to infer per-token utility scores that adjust the logits. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that FLEET achieves the same accuracy as the repeated sampling baseline, with a 3x speedup, and substantially improves accuracy on complex coding tasks (LiveCodeBench Pass@32 increases from 59.9% to 66.2%) under the same budget. Furthermore, in the greedy-decoding configuration evaluated here, the approach is deterministic and uses a single calibration pass to derive its principal hyperparameters, requiring only minimal modifications to existing LLM pipelines.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Algorithm source code and experiments: https://github.com/Alexiush/fleet
articles.titleCn: FLEET：从文本生成中的逻辑熵到增强轨迹
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的解决方案通常通过聚合多个来自完成分布的样本来依赖温度采样，从而提高准确性和稳定性。然而，这种无记忆的方法本质上是不理想的：因为它缺乏对先前生成及其评估的意识，随着更多样本的抽取，它会产生越来越多的语义重复答案，导致收益递减。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了FLEET，这是一种将记忆机制集成到生成过程中的创新方法。FLEET将每个生成表示为通过熵超过预设阈值的状态的稀疏轨迹，并使用这些轨迹来推断每个标记的效用分数，从而调整logits。基准评估表明，FLEET在相同的预算下，实现了与重复采样基线相同的准确率，速度提升了3倍，并在复杂的编码任务上显著提高了准确率（LiveCodeBench Pass@32从59.9%提升到66.2%）。此外，在本评估中采用的贪婪解码配置下，该方法具有确定性，并使用单次校准过程来推导其主要超参数，仅需对现有的LLM流程进行最小限度的修改。

articles.title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
articles.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.
articles.titleCn: 路径很重要：在知识图谱问答中超越答案准确率评估小语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型（SLMs）正越来越多地与知识图谱（KGs）结合使用，然而端到端的KG问答将图访问、搜索、导航、推理和答案生成混为一谈。这种结合使得难以判断SLM是否能够忠实地执行问题所隐含的推理路径，也难以将失败归因于导航阶段而非管道的其他阶段。我们通过采用THESEUS导航和可追溯性框架，并使用冻结的现成SLMs作为本地动作策略，将这一能力分离出来。在每个步骤中，环境暴露合法的出边图动作，模型选择一个可执行的图动作并决定是否停止，而无需进行特定任务的参数更新、模型控制的束搜索或自由形式的答案生成。这种受控设置使我们能够使用Path Edit Distance（PED）作为主要轨迹指标，结合Hits@1评估终端答案准确性和路径保真度。在Kinship和MQuAKE-ST KG问答任务中，规模相似的本地模型在答案准确性和路径保真度上存在显著差异，有时这两个指标会偏向不同的模型。这种模型相关的行为也扩展到提示，单个演示轨迹根据不同的模型可能会改善或恶化导航。这些结果促使我们在仅评估终点准确性的基础上，进一步评估SLM的图推理能力。

articles.title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: Evaluating JEV and Language Models for Legal Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Contract inference requires multiple judgments about a shared document, but aggregate accuracy can conceal changes in the individual decisions. Repeated agreement is also insufficient: a model may consistently return the wrong answer. In this paper, we compare Jev with nine language models on ContractNLI, evaluating inference cost, response time, average correctness, and correctness across repeated request conditions. Controlled comparisons vary hypothesis visibility, requested outputs, and output order while keeping the contract and target judgment fixed. Jev has the lowest cost and median response time among the evaluated configurations, while hosted language models achieve higher baseline accuracy. Rankings by baseline accuracy differ from rankings by correctness across every condition and repeat, although small differences in the latter do not establish a general stability advantage. Development diagnostics further reveal compensating corrections and regressions, as well as persistent errors. These findings motivate evaluating cost and response time alongside whether individual judgments remain correct as the request configuration changes. Code: https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-Benchmark
articles.titleCn: 相同分数，不同决策：评估 JEV 和语言模型在法律文件理解方面的表现
articles.abstractCn: 合约推理需要对共享文档进行多次判断，但总体准确率可能掩盖个体决策中的变化。重复的共识也不够充分：模型可能始终返回错误答案。在本文中，我们在ContractNLI上比较了Jev与九个语言模型，评估推理成本、响应时间、平均正确性和重复请求条件下的正确性。受控比较中，假设可见性、请求输出和输出顺序各不相同，而合约和目标判断保持固定。Jev在评估配置中具有最低成本和中位数响应时间，而托管语言模型实现了更高的基线准确率。基线准确率的排名与每个条件和重复条件下的正确性排名不同，尽管后者的小差异并未建立普遍的稳定性优势。开发诊断进一步揭示了补偿性纠正和退化，以及持续存在的错误。这些发现促使我们在请求配置变化时，评估成本和响应时间，同时评估个体判断是否仍然正确。代码：https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-Benchmark

articles.title: Consequential Behaviour and Representational Fairness in the Validation of Synthetic Research
articles.abstract: Researchers in industry and academia use synthetic survey respondents powered by large language models as substitutes for human samples. These synthetic populations require validation against real-world data, so researchers often address them using ad hoc comparisons with human surveys. Inspired by the intention-behaviour gap in behavioural science, we argue that these validations test the wrong thing for most applied cases where decision makers commission synthetic research to anticipate consequential behaviour. To address this problem, we propose a validation framework with two requirements. First, every validity claim must state its level of correspondence with human data: does the sample predict what the represented people do, which of four diagnostics (location, dispersion, response process and structure) does the validation address, and does the validation compare against experimental effects? Second, researchers must report validity claims for subgroups, since these groups are often the most affected by consequential decisions and aggregate accuracy hides their misrepresentation. Our validation framework operationalises three justice dimensions (distributional, procedural, and recognition) as measurable quantities and defines within-persona counterfactual experiments as a validation requirement. We then apply the framework to electric vehicle charging tariffs, before closing with a reporting checklist that researchers can use to make convincing validity claims.
articles.titleCn: 合成研究的验证中的结果行为与表征公平
articles.abstractCn: 工业界和学术界的研究人员使用由大型语言模型驱动的合成调查受访者作为人类样本的替代品。这些合成人群需要与真实世界数据进行验证，因此研究人员通常通过与人调查的临时性比较来处理它们。受行为科学中意图-行为差距的启发，我们认为在这些验证中，大多数实际应用案例（决策者委托合成研究以预测具有重大影响的行为）测试了错误的东西。为解决这个问题，我们提出一个包含两个要求的验证框架。首先，每个有效性声明必须说明其与人类数据的对应程度：样本是否预测了所代表人群的行为，验证针对的是四个诊断中的哪一个（位置、分散度、响应过程和结构），以及验证是否与实验效应进行比较？其次，研究人员必须报告子群体的有效性声明，因为这些群体通常是受重大决策影响最大的群体，而汇总准确度会掩盖它们的错误表述。我们的验证框架将三个正义维度（分配性、程序性和认可性）操作化为可测量的量，并将个人角色反事实实验定义为验证要求。然后我们将该框架应用于电动汽车充电费率，最后提供一个研究人员可以使用以做出令人信服的有效性声明的报告清单。

articles.title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
articles.abstract: Human-written agent skills encode rich workflows for real-world problem solving, but are typically used as external inference-time instructions rather than internalized as reusable model capabilities. We introduce \texttt{SkillGym}, a framework that transforms these skills into executable, verifiable training environments for large language model agents. Its skill-to-task pipeline instantiates concrete tasks, verifies outcomes with code-based checkers, and assesses empirical skill dependence through contrastive executions. We construct and release 2,756 environments across 12 categories and collect 8,364 successful trajectories from multiple models and harnesses, averaging 49 tool calls and over 60k logged text tokens. These resources support supervised fine-tuning on verified workflows and reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Under Claude Code, supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 199 Elo on GDPval-AA v2, 19.10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 28.13 and 12.38 points on SkillsBench v1.1 with and without skills, respectively. Our 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} reaches 51.47\% on skill-assisted SkillsBench, exceeding reported scores for Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 Mini, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Without skills, it also surpasses skill-assisted bases under Codex and Claude Code, suggesting reusable procedural competence.
articles.titleCn: SkillGym：将人类技能内化于大型语言模型以解决现实世界问题
articles.abstractCn: 人类编写的代理技能为现实世界问题解决编码了丰富的流程，但通常仅作为推理时的外部指令使用，而非内化为可复用的模型能力。我们引入了SkillGym框架，将这类技能转化为大型语言模型代理的可执行、可验证训练环境。其技能到任务的流水线能够实例化具体任务，通过代码检查器验证结果，并通过对比执行评估经验技能依赖性。我们构建并发布了涵盖12类别的2,756个环境，并从多个模型和引擎中收集了8,364条成功轨迹，平均包含49次工具调用和超过60k条记录的文本标记。这些资源支持在验证工作流上进行监督微调和基于结果的奖励强化学习。在Claude Code下，监督微调使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在GDPval-AA v2上的Elo评分提升了199分，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上提升了19.10个百分点，在有技能和无技能的情况下，在SkillsBench v1.1上的得分分别达到了28.13分和12.38分。我们的35B SkillGym-Agent在技能辅助的SkillsBench上达到了51.47%的成绩，超过了Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4 Mini和DeepSeek V4 Pro的公开成绩。在没有技能的情况下，它也超越了Codex和Claude Code下的技能辅助基线，表明了可复用的程序性能力。

articles.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
articles.abstract: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational questions and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.
articles.titleCn: 对预训练模型在评估新型AI辅助教育问题教学中的应用进行评价
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能辅助生成教育材料的现象已超出我们对其教学质量验证的能力。使用布卢姆分类器模型进行自动化评估是大规模评估教育材料的一种有前景的方法。这些模型在分布内数据集（IID Dataset）中表现出高精度。然而，将相同模型应用于新的分布外（OOD）数据集，如人工智能辅助生成的问题，可能会出现性能下降。为在数据集偏移下识别鲁棒的分类器，我们评估了传统机器学习（ML）、Transformer和大型语言模型在布卢姆分类任务上的表现。我们还探索了结合自然语言处理指标、将学习目标作为输入的一部分以及文本拼接等特征工程策略，以稳定分布外性能。我们的基线测试显示，TFPOS-IDF机器学习模型在分布外数据集上的表现较差（宏观F1分数为0.48），而BERT（0.55）和LLM（0.79）表现更好。文本拼接提高了机器学习和BERT模型的宏观F1分数（分别为0.59和0.62）。将学习目标作为输入增加了模型在特定数据集上的性能。模型再训练在所有模型和数据集上提供了最大的改进。总体而言，这些发现突出了使用预训练模型与新型人工智能辅助教育问题之间的权衡，以及如何通过战略性的特征增强来弥补性能损失。

articles.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
articles.abstract: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).
articles.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Generalizing from Limited Resources in the Open World workshop at International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
articles.titleCn: 六层更少：Whisper的编码器剪枝与无标签恢复
articles.abstractCn: 对大型预训练的基于Transformer的语音识别（ASR）模型（如OpenAI的Whisper）进行剪枝已被广泛采用，因为剪枝解码器显著提高了端到端的转录速度。例如，{\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo}变体将解码器层数从32层减少到4层，而Distill-Whisper同样将解码器减少到仅2层。尽管一些研究关注于减小编码器的大小，但尚无方法得到广泛采用。这可能是因为需要定制推理实现才能利用压缩后的模型。我们提出了一种通过留一层的Word Error Rate（WER）变化对编码器层进行排序的方法。移除变化最少的六层，对应于编码器堆栈的$18.5\%$。剪枝后的模型无需定制推理代码，因为它只是一个更浅的编码器，层数更少。我们进一步使用未标记的单语语音数据进行蒸馏，以恢复因零样本层剪枝造成的性能下降。在四个语言上的平均WER在蒸馏后增加到$20.1\%$，相比零样本的$21.9\%$，从基线$18.2\%$提升。我们发布了所有代码（https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune）和剪枝后的模型（https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned）。

articles.title: Risk-Controlled KV-Cache Eviction: From Memory Budgets to Risk Targets
articles.abstract: KV-cache eviction is typically evaluated through average quality-memory trade-offs, yet a small average loss can hide requests whose utility degrades materially. We reformulate eviction as a deployment risk-control problem: a material degradation occurs when eviction lowers task utility by more than a deployment-specified tolerance relative to full-KV inference on the same request, and deployment risk is the population frequency of such events. Given a reliability contract specifying a target risk level and confidence requirement, we use a compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure to select a retention policy from calibration data with a finite-sample guarantee, falling back to full KV when no compressed policy is certified. Across multiple eviction methods, Llama and Mistral models, and LongBench and RULER-32K, the same contract supports substantially different levels of eviction: on Llama, it certifies SnapKV at 75% retention on LongBench but no tested compressed policy on RULER-32K, triggering full-KV fallback. Policies with empirical degradation rates below the 5% target can still fail finite-sample certification; on Llama LongBench, empirical thresholding selects uncertified policies that retain 5-10 percentage points less cache across fixed-budget methods. The proposed framework converts a deployment-level reliability requirement into a KV-memory operating point.
articles.titleCn: 基于风险控制的KV缓存驱逐：从内存预算到风险目标
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存驱逐通常通过平均质量与内存的权衡来评估，但一个小的平均损失可能掩盖那些效用显著下降的请求。我们将驱逐重新定义为部署风险控制问题：当驱逐导致任务效用下降超过部署指定的容限时，就会发生显著退化，部署风险是此类事件的群体频率。给定一个指定目标风险水平和置信度要求的可靠性合约，我们使用与压缩器无关的事后认证程序，从校准数据中选择保留策略，并保证有限样本的可靠性，若无压缩策略通过认证则回退到全KV。在多种驱逐方法、Llama和Mistral模型以及LongBench和RULER-32K上，同一合约支持截然不同的驱逐水平：在Llama上，它在LongBench上认证SnapKV以75%的保留率，但在RULER-32K上未测试任何压缩策略，触发全KV回退。经验退化率低于5%目标的策略仍可能无法通过有限样本认证；在Llama LongBench上，经验阈值选择保留缓存减少5-10个百分点的未认证策略。所提出的框架将部署级的可靠性要求转化为KV内存的操作点。

articles.title: Controlled Attribute-Specific Summarization of Interrogative Dialogues
articles.abstract: Effective summarization of interrogative dialogues is a critical task in forensic and investigative settings, requiring high factual accuracy, coherence, and attribute-specific relevance. In this work, we introduce CASPER, a novel Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization framework that leverages structured prompting and iterative refinement to generate high-quality summaries of interrogator-witness interactions. We construct MINDSum, a dataset extending the MIND corpus, comprising 6,000 utterance pairs annotated with event details, factual statements, character descriptions, and fillers. CASPER employs RoleEval, a hierarchical evaluation mechanism where multiple roles (officer, inspector, senior inspector) iteratively assess summaries based on predefined criteria. By integrating entity extraction and structured feedback loops, CASPER significantly improves factual consistency and contextual completeness compared to existing baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard summarization models on both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) metrics, while human evaluation confirms its alignment with expert reasoning. Our findings underscore the potential of controlled summarization in high-stakes domains, paving the way for AI-driven forensic intelligence.
articles.titleCn: 疑问对话的属性特定控制性摘要
articles.abstractCn: 在法医和调查场景中，对询问对话进行有效总结是一项关键任务，需要具备高事实准确性、连贯性和属性特定相关性。在这项工作中，我们引入了CASPER，这是一个新颖的推理链属性特定提示评估性总结框架，该框架利用结构化提示和迭代优化来生成高质量的询问者-证人互动总结。我们构建了MINDSum数据集，这是对MIND语料库的扩展，包含6,000对标注了事件细节、事实陈述、人物描述和填充词的语句。CASPER采用RoleEval，这是一种分层评估机制，其中多个角色（警官、检查员、高级检查员）根据预定义标准迭代评估总结。通过整合实体提取和结构化反馈循环，CASPER与现有基线相比，显著提高了事实一致性和上下文完整性。实验结果表明，我们的框架在词汇（ROUGE）和语义（BERTScore）指标上均优于标准总结模型，而人工评估也证实其与专家推理的一致性。我们的研究强调了受控总结在高风险领域的潜力，为人工智能驱动的法医情报铺平了道路。

articles.title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Turkish Domain Documents Under Retrieval and Hardware Constraints
articles.abstract: Most Turkish-capable large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using general-purpose benchmarks rather than long, structurally complex domain documents. This paper evaluates five open-weight 7B-8B models for Turkish document question answering under a resource-constrained local deployment setting. The primary benchmark contains 100 systematically validated questions derived from a 109-page industrial R&D report, and the evaluation protocol is replicated using a second 112-page public-sector report and an independently constructed 100-question set. All models are evaluated locally on an NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop GPU with 6 GB VRAM using controlled prompting, decoding, and 4-bit quantisation. The principal methodological contribution is an evidence-annotated evaluation protocol that separates retrieval failure from downstream model reasoning failure without requiring additional model calls. On the primary benchmark, end-to-end accuracy ranges from 49% to 75%. Seven lexical, dense, and hybrid retrieval configurations are additionally compared using 95% Wilson intervals and exact paired McNemar tests; none significantly outperforms the character TF-IDF baseline on either document. Evidence recall saturates differently across the two reports, showing that retrieval and effective context capacity can be binding constraints for some documents but not others. These results demonstrate that model selection, retrieval behaviour, and hardware limits must be evaluated separately when deploying open-weight LLMs for Turkish domain documents.
articles.titleCn: 在检索和硬件限制下评估适用于土耳其领域文档的开权量大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 目前大多数针对土耳其语的大型语言模型（LLMs）通常使用通用基准进行评估，而非长篇且结构复杂的领域文档。本文在资源受限的本地部署环境下，评估了五种开放权重的7B-8B模型在土耳其语文档问答任务中的表现。主要基准包含100个从109页工业研发报告中系统验证的问题，评估协议通过第二个112页的公共部门报告和独立构建的100问题集进行复现。所有模型均在配备6GB显存的NVIDIA RTX 3050笔记本电脑GPU上，通过受控的提示、解码和4位量化进行本地评估。主要方法论贡献在于提出了一种证据标注的评估协议，该协议能够将检索失败与下游模型推理失败区分开来，而无需额外的模型调用。在主要基准上，端到端准确率范围在49%至75%之间。此外，使用95%威尔逊区间和精确配对麦克尼玛检验，比较了七种词汇检索、密集检索和混合检索配置；在两种文档上，均无任何配置显著优于字符TF-IDF基线。证据召回在两种报告中的饱和情况不同，表明检索和有效上下文容量对某些文档是限制因素，而对另一些文档则不是。这些结果表明，在为土耳其语领域文档部署开放权重LLMs时，模型选择、检索行为和硬件限制必须分别进行评估。

articles.title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
articles.abstract: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.
articles.titleCn: 评估LLM生成反馈在学生写作中的反馈焦点和教学适应性
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了最先进的语言模型（LLM）在反馈重点和适应性方面是否生成反映专家教师教学实践的反馈。以往的评价工作已考察了反馈特征、其对学习的影响及其目标，但反馈的重点及其适应性仍被 largely overlooked。为弥补这一差距，我们采用并完善了Narciss的分类法，将其分为七种反馈重点类型，用于标注三个大学写作课程中的教师和LLM生成的反馈。我们发布了FeedType，这是一个基准，包含来自六个LLM在三种提示策略下的教师和LLM反馈的标注。我们评估了反馈重点类型的覆盖范围和分布，并考察了LLM是否像专家教师一样，根据草稿阶段和学生的表现水平调整反馈。我们的研究结果表明，尽管大多数LLM涵盖了大多数反馈重点类型，但它们未能反映教师反馈的分布，并且在适应性方面表现各异，没有一种能匹配教师的适应性行为。我们相信FeedType将支持未来关于LLM反馈生成中教学一致性的研究。

articles.title: Tensor Decomposition of Transformer Key-Value Caches: Spectral Structure and Format Comparison
articles.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers can be viewed as a fourth-order tensor spanning attention heads, tokens, features, and grouped layers. We measure the singular-value spectra of all four mode unfoldings on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and LLaMA-2-13B and compare four standard tensor decompositions: Tucker, CP, tensor train, and t-SVD, at matched storage. The spectra partition the four axes into two classes. The token and feature modes carry low-rank structure, particularly for keys. The head and layer modes are nearly full-rank and resist compression at any practical error level. Among the four decompositions, Tucker achieves the lowest reconstruction error at every compression ratio from $2\times$ to $5\times$, because it can leave the full-rank modes untouched. Comparisons with two-dimensional unfolding baselines show that the preferred representation differs between keys and values: 2D methods achieve lower key error, while four-way Tucker achieves lower value error at matched storage. A mode-pinning theorem certifies the full-rank preservation from the measured spectra alone. Two further spectral properties affect the compressible modes without touching the full-rank ones: values reach a higher error floor than keys at every ratio, and post-RoPE keys lose $41\%$ - $64\%$ of their pre-RoPE compressibility on both models.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications (SIMAX)
articles.titleCn: Transformer Key-Value 缓存的张量分解：谱结构和格式比较
articles.abstractCn: 自回归转换器的键值（KV）缓存可以被视为一个四阶张量，跨越注意力头、标记、特征和分组层。我们在Mistral-7B-v0.3和LLaMA-2-13B上测量了所有四个模式展开的奇异值谱，并在匹配存储下比较了四种标准张量分解：Tucker、CP、张量链和t-SVD。这些谱将四个轴划分为两类。标记和特征模式具有低秩结构，尤其是对于键。头和层模式接近满秩，并且在任何实际误差水平下都难以压缩。在四种分解中，Tucker在2倍到5倍的每一种压缩率下都实现了最低的重建误差，因为它可以保留满秩模式不变。与二维展开基线的比较表明，键和值的优选表示有所不同：二维方法实现了更低的键误差，而四维Tucker在匹配存储下实现了更低的值误差。一个模式固定定理仅通过测量的谱就证明了满秩的保持。另外两种谱特性影响了可压缩模式，而不触及满秩模式：值在每一种比率下都达到了比键更高的误差下限，并且后RoPE键在两个模型上都失去了41%至64%的RoPE前压缩性。

articles.title: How Much Were You Told? Measuring External Information in Peer Reviews
articles.abstract: Conference policies distinguish using Large Language Models (LLMs) to polish one's own review from delegating the critique, but current Artificial Text Detection (ATD) methods largely measure surface form rather than the origin of its content. We instead measure the external information carried by a review: information not explained by the reviewed paper and a generic reviewing instruction. We propose Self-Conditioning, an unsupervised information-theoretic estimator that compares the likelihood of a review under its production context with its likelihood when that context is augmented with hints extracted from the review itself. On the IntelLabs peer-review benchmark, Self-Conditioning separates fully-delegated from machine-polished reviews with AUC up to $1.0$ while remaining largely insensitive to surface rewriting. Moreover, as generators receive increasing amounts of externally-provided information, their scores move monotonically towards the human regime, unlike standard ATD baselines. High-temperature sampling can evade the estimator, but at the cost of output quality.
articles.titleCn: 你被告知多少？在同行评审中衡量外部信息
articles.abstractCn: 会议政策区分了使用大型语言模型（LLM）润色自身评审与委托评审两种行为，但当前的人工文本检测（ATD）方法主要衡量文本的表面形式而非其内容的来源。我们则测量评审所携带的外部信息：这些信息无法由被评审论文和通用的评审指令解释。我们提出了Self-Conditioning，这是一种无监督的信息论估计器，它比较评审在其生成环境下出现的可能性与其在加入从评审本身提取的线索后该环境下的可能性。在IntelLabs同行评审基准上，Self-Conditioning能够以高达1.0的AUC将完全委托的评审与机器润色的评审区分开来，同时对其表面重写基本不敏感。此外，随着生成器接收越来越多的外部提供信息，它们的分数单调地接近人类范围，这与标准的ATD基线不同。高温采样可以规避估计器，但代价是输出质量下降。

articles.title: TEMPS: Temporal Sentence Embeddings for Temporal Information Retrieval
articles.abstract: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS), a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS- Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.
articles.titleCn: TEMPS：用于时间信息检索的时间句子嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 现代信息检索（IR）系统很少表示时间，但许多信息需求依赖于时间：在临床、新闻和法律搜索中，事件发生的时间可以决定文档是否相关。密集检索器和检索增强生成（RAG）管道在主题匹配上表现良好，但在时间匹配上表现不佳，因此它们会展示出主题相关但时间错误的內容。我们引入了时间文本相似度（TTS），这是一个衡量两个锚定文本在时间上如何对齐的任务，而与它们的主题相似度无关。然后我们提出了TEMPS（精确搜索的时间嵌入模型），这是一个模块化的时间分支，它连接到一个冻结的语义检索器，并在该信号上进行训练。它将锚定的时间表达式解析为时间间隔，并将每一个与高斯分布匹配；由此产生的排序监督一个锚定日期条件编码器，其分数我们在推理时与语义分数进行融合。锚定提供了监督，因此训练不需要人工标记的时间数据。时间分数本身是分布嵌入中的高斯KL包含度量；TEMPS增加的是锚定和时刻匹配的监督。在三个时间基准测试中，TEMPS提高了所有测试的语义主干MRR，并且在TS-Retriever上，将R@1从19.92提升到25.39，超越了之前的时间最佳水平。

articles.title: Exact Quantile Balancing and Load-Error Injection for Mixture-of-Experts
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with negligible communication, and Load-Error Injection (LEI), which injects local load errors directly into router-score gradients. On 7.5B-parameter MoEs trained for up to 500B tokens, EQB improves global balance and downstream performance over naive QB, while LEI improves local balance and outperforms the GShard loss at comparable quality.
articles.titleCn: 精确专家混合模型的分位数平衡和负载-误差注入
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）训练需要全局负载均衡以防止专家未被充分利用，并需要局部均衡以实现高效的专家并行执行。现有的分布式分位数均衡（QB）使用基于分片或近似的全局分位数，而与标记无关的专家偏差无法确保微批次级别的均衡。我们引入了精确分位数均衡（EQB），它以可忽略的通信量计算精确的全局批次BF16分位数，并引入了负载误差注入（LEI），它将局部负载误差直接注入路由器分数梯度中。在训练参数高达7.5B的MoE模型处理高达500B个标记时，EQB在全局均衡和下游性能方面优于原始QB，而LEI在局部均衡方面表现更优，并在同等质量下优于GShard损失。

articles.title: A Native-Reference Coordinate Geometry for L2 Pronunciation Deviation Using Self-Supervised Speech Models
articles.abstract: Self-supervised speech models encode rich phonetic information, but it remains unclear how to transform this information into interpretable metrics for second-language (L2) pronunciation assessment in spontaneous speech. We propose a native-reference coordinate geometry in which phone-class averages from native speech define a low-dimensional reference subspace, and L2 speech is evaluated by its distance to matching native phone-class coordinates. Unlike prior distance-based approaches, our method does not require parallel recordings with matched linguistic content or dedicated pronunciation labels. Across different self-supervised encoders and modeling choices, the resulting native-reference distances show negative Spearman correlations up to -0.5 with speaking proficiency, indicating that higher-proficiency speakers tend to lie closer to the native-reference space.
articles.titleCn: 一种用于L2发音偏差的本征参考坐标几何，基于自监督语音模型
articles.abstractCn: 自监督语音模型能够编码丰富的语音信息，但如何将这些信息转化为用于第二语言（L2）自发语音发音评估的可解释指标仍不明确。我们提出了一种以母语为参考的坐标几何方法，其中母语语音的音素类别平均值定义了一个低维参考子空间，L2语音通过其与匹配的母语音素类别坐标的距离进行评估。与先前的基于距离的方法不同，我们的方法无需匹配语言内容的并行录音或专门的发音标签。在不同的自监督编码器和建模选择下，得到的母语参考距离与口语水平呈负斯皮尔曼相关性，最高可达-0.5，表明发音水平较高的说话者倾向于更靠近母语参考空间。

articles.title: Reference-Based Analysis of Coherence and Diversity in Open-Ended Text Generation
articles.abstract: Evaluating open-ended text generation involves understanding how different properties of a continuation relate to its perceived quality. We present a reference-based framework for examining coherence and diversity through three perspectives: aligning their evolution with human trajectories, comparing their summaries with a human continuation of the same prompt, and estimating their likelihood under a human reference distribution. Experiments with human quality ratings suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture quality-related variation, although the comparisons do not establish a predictive advantage for temporal alignment over simpler baselines. Reference likelihood also shows positive associations with ratings, with results varying across reference configurations and scoring horizons. Together, these analyses provide a structured way to examine how measured coherence and diversity relate to human judgments, while distinguishing similarity to human references from quality itself. Code and analysis resources are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human.
articles.titleCn: 基于参考的开放文本生成中连贯性与多样性分析
articles.abstractCn: 评估开放式文本生成涉及理解续写不同属性与其感知质量之间的关系。我们提出一个基于参考的框架，通过三个视角来检验连贯性和多样性：将它们的演变与人类轨迹对齐，将它们的摘要与对相同提示的人类续写进行比较，以及根据人类参考分布估计其可能性。基于人类质量评分的实验表明，基于多样性的对齐和基于均值的比较能够捕捉与质量相关的变化，尽管比较并未证明时间对齐相对于更简单的基线具有预测优势。参考可能性也与评分呈正相关，但结果因参考配置和评分范围不同而有所差异。综合来看，这些分析提供了一种结构化的方法来检验测量的连贯性和多样性如何与人类判断相关联，同时区分了与人类参考的相似性本身与质量。代码和分析资源可在 https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human 获取。

articles.title: Can LLMs Catch a Rigged Backtest? A Clean-Control Calibration Benchmark
articles.abstract: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0\% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8\% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5\% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8\% (95\% CI 11.7--34.3) to 0.0\% (0.0--7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否识破操纵过的回测？一项干净控制校准基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 回测审计是一个校准问题：当模型错误地标记匹配的干净策略时，高缺陷召回率并无用处。我们构建了一个包含96项配对基准，其中每个有缺陷的回测都有一个干净的对照，策略、日期、代码风格、标签和报告框架保持固定，仅改变一个方法细节。一个确定性评分器将缺陷召回率、干净对照假阳性、证据定位和修复相关性分开。在来自四个文本端点的1440次缓存审计中，主要的DeepSeek审计器达到了100.0%的关闭和干净感知代码召回率，但开放提示错误标记了93.8%的干净代码对照，而干净感知所有三项特异性即使在召回饱和时也仅为87.5%。一个干净感知警告将DeepSeek代码假阳性从20.8%（95% CI 11.7--34.3）降至0.0%（0.0--7.4），在召回率不变的情况下，而预算锚点在相同提示下仍标记了38/48个干净对照。仅报告召回率会使这四个模型中的三个排名相同；而报告干净对照率则将它们区分了79分。

articles.title: Scaling Attention Head Analysis via Gradient-Based Attribution in Context-Aware Machine Translation
articles.abstract: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We empirically show the alignment of our method with the effects of increasing the attention scores of token-to-token relations on three models and two language directions, ensuring the robustness of our method. Our analysis reveals the presence of the "general-purpose" attention heads that improve the model's performance when attending to different relations. We find that the average attention a head assigns to a relation does not necessarily relate to the model's performance, which suggests that the models developed redundancies during training in terms of the head functions.
articles.titleCn: 基于梯度归因的上下文感知机器翻译中注意力头的扩展分析
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种基于梯度的头归因策略，其中Token级别的最大间隔损失被反向传播到注意力图中。该框架能够对注意力头进行大规模的因果分析，适用于大型语言模型。我们在情境感知机器翻译中的消歧任务上评估了我们的方法，分析了4个模型和4种语言方向下的50种现象。我们通过实证研究证明了我们的方法与增加token间关系注意力分数的效果的一致性，从而确保了方法的鲁棒性。我们的分析揭示了存在“通用型”注意力头，它们在关注不同关系时能够提升模型性能。我们发现，一个头平均分配给关系的注意力并不一定与模型性能相关，这表明模型在训练过程中在头功能方面存在冗余。

articles.title: Exact Feedback Is Not Control: Evaluating Text-based Closed-Loop Revision in LLMs
articles.abstract: Closed-loop revision is increasingly used in large language model (LLM) applications, but failures may reflect incomplete feedback or ineffective responses to correct feedback. We introduce a fixed-budget revision protocol with deterministic verifiers that report all remaining violations across exact-length, lexical, and compositional constraints. Fixing feedback correctness and completeness isolates model-side revision behavior. Across 19 open- and closed-source models, controller-level mean final joint success ranges from 17.4% to 99.8%, with substantial cross-model gaps persisting under identical initial drafts. Controlled experiments reveal reproducible model-specific responses to exact feedback. Post-training and scale reshape these responses without consistently bringing them closer to exact correction. Across all constraint families, failed trajectories often repeat earlier outputs, and prior recurrence is associated with lower subsequent recoverability. Matched-state interventions show that removing earlier dialogue while holding the current draft and feedback fixed changes recurrence escape without reliably improving final success; effects depend on the model, task, and trigger-state composition. Exact feedback makes revision errors observable, but does not make the closed loop reliable. Code and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code.
articles.titleCn: 精确反馈并非控制：评估大型语言模型中的基于文本的闭环修订
articles.abstractCn: 闭环修订在大型语言模型（LLM）应用中越来越普遍，但失败可能反映出反馈不完整或对正确反馈的响应无效。我们引入了一种固定预算修订协议，该协议使用确定性验证器，可报告所有剩余的精确长度、词汇和组合约束违规行为。纠正反馈的正确性和完整性隔离了模型端的修订行为。在19个开源和闭源模型中，控制器层面的平均最终联合成功率介于17.4%至99.8%，在相同的初始草稿下，模型间存在显著的差距。受控实验揭示了模型对精确反馈的特定可重复响应。训练后和规模重塑这些响应，但并未始终使它们更接近精确修正。在所有约束类别中，失败的轨迹常常重复先前的输出，而先前重复与后续可恢复性较低相关。匹配状态干预表明，在保持当前草稿和反馈固定的情况下移除早期对话，可以改变重复逃逸，但并不可靠地提高最终成功率；效果取决于模型、任务和触发状态组合。精确反馈使修订错误变得可见，但并未使闭环可靠。代码和复现说明：https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code。

articles.title: PASTABench: Proactive Assessment of Sequential Trajectories for Agent Safety
articles.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents that alter real-world states, ensuring operational safety across multi-step workflows has become a critical challenge. While recent work has moved beyond single-turn evaluation toward multi-turn paradigms, key limitations persist: step-level methods treat actions in isolation, missing how risks accumulate, while trajectory-level evaluations operate post-hoc, offering no opportunity for timely intervention. To address these limitations, we formalize Decoupled Proactive Safety Monitoring along three dimensions: whether to intervene, when to intervene, and what the risk is. We introduce PASTABench, a benchmark of 1,139 multi-turn trajectories spanning 5 risk categories and 13 subcategories. We further propose the Optimal Intervention Window (OIW), anchored by annotated Earliest-Signal and Trigger turns, to quantify intervention timeliness. Evaluation of 16 LLMs reveals that proactive intervention remains largely unsolved, with the best model achieving only 40.74% optimal-timing interventions. Fine-grained diagnosis further uncovers pervasive lexical overfitting: competitive safety scores of smaller models mask keyword hypersensitivity rather than genuine risk comprehension, as their proactive capability largely collapses once hazard vocabulary is neutralized.
articles.titleCn: PASTABench：针对智能体安全的序列轨迹主动评估
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）演变为能够改变现实世界状态的自主代理，确保跨多步骤工作流程的操作安全已成为一项关键挑战。尽管近期研究已从单轮评估转向多轮范式，但关键局限性依然存在：步骤级方法将动作孤立处理，忽略了风险的累积方式，而轨迹级评估是在事后进行的，没有提供及时干预的机会。为解决这些局限性，我们沿三个维度形式化了解耦主动安全监控：是否干预、何时干预以及风险是什么。我们引入了PASTABench，这是一个包含1139个多轮轨迹的基准，涵盖5个风险类别和13个子类别。我们进一步提出了最优干预窗口（OIW），以标注的最早信号和触发轮为基准，量化干预的及时性。对16个LLMs的评估显示，主动干预仍面临重大挑战，最佳模型的及时干预率仅为40.74%。细粒度诊断进一步揭示了普遍的词汇过拟合问题：较小模型的竞争性安全评分掩盖了关键词超敏感性而非真正的风险理解，因为一旦消除危险词汇，其主动能力就会大幅下降。

articles.title: Log-Depth Recurrent Language Modeling
articles.abstract: Language modeling using Transformers has become commonplace despite their fixed computational depth and quadratic runtime with respect to input tokens. Recurrent models on the other hand offer linear depth but no parallel execution. In this work, we extend balanced-tree recursive operators from sequence encoding to autoregressive prediction, enabling all prefix representations to be computed with logarithmic depth and linear runtime. Our experiments provide an initial characterization of this model class, demonstrating robust length extrapolation and performance approaching that of ALiBi-based Transformers, highlighting its potential as an alternative architecture for language modeling.
articles.titleCn: 对数深度循环语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 尽管Transformer在计算深度固定且相对于输入token的时间复杂度为二次方，但基于Transformer的语言建模已成为常态。而循环模型虽然具有线性深度，却无法并行执行。在这项工作中，我们扩展了平衡树递归算子，将其从序列编码扩展到自回归预测，使得所有前缀表示都可以以对数深度和线性时间复杂度进行计算。我们的实验初步刻画了该模型类别，展示了其强大的长度外推能力和接近基于ALiBi的Transformer的性能，突显了其作为语言建模替代架构的潜力。

articles.title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj.
articles.titleCn: 超越诗歌：大型语言模型能否生成古典阿拉伯马卡姆？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在创意文本生成方面表现出色，但其在生成具有文化根基和风格约束的文学形式方面的能力仍待深入探索。以往研究主要集中于现代语言变体和诗歌，而诸如麦卡玛（maqama）等古典散文传统则基本未得到研究。麦卡玛是一种以韵文散文（saj）、密集的修辞装饰和片段式叙事结构为特征的古典文学体裁，使其成为评估LLMs是否能够超越表面流畅性、迈向更深层次文学能力的挑战性试验场。在本文中，我们首次对LLMs生成的麦卡玛进行了受控评估研究，比较了五种模型在零样本、少样本和基于规则的提示下的表现，并通过人工标注和将LLM作为评判者框架，从修辞丰富性、saj密度、结构连贯性和风格真实性等多个维度评估输出结果。我们的结果表明，提示策略对风格质量有显著影响：少样本提示最稳定地提高了saj密度，而其对修辞和连贯性的影响因模型而异，最强的模型（GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini）在这些维度上从基于规则的提示中获益最多，尽管零样本提示在所有五种模型中获得了最高的综合评分。我们进一步观察到不同模型在风格上与阿拉伯麦卡玛传统的一致性存在系统性差异，并通过配对统计显著性检验和saj的非LLM代理指标验证了我们的发现。

articles.title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
articles.abstract: At test time, large language models (LLMs) can encode historical information in activation memory (i.e., KV caches) and parametric memory (i.e., updated parameters). While activation memory is generally considered effective for factual recall and parametric memory for learning new tasks, their interplay remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of memory in few-shot learning through controlled experiments. We find that activation memory is superior for recalling facts, whereas parametric memory does not consistently outperform activation memory in task learning. Moreover, our experiments show that the composite task, Conditional Arithmetic, requires the synergy of both memory types. Through neuron-level analysis, we find that the model activates distinct sets of neurons when accessing the same historical information through activation versus parametric memory. When both memory types are combined, the model recruits neurons from both sets, which is crucial for solving Conditional Arithmetic. These findings suggest that neither memory mechanism alone is sufficient for this composite task, highlighting the importance of their collaboration.
articles.titleCn: 激活与参数化记忆在少样本学习中的互补作用
articles.abstractCn: 在测试阶段，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以在激活记忆（即，KV缓存）中编码历史信息，并在参数记忆（即，更新参数）中进行存储。虽然激活记忆通常被认为对事实回忆有效，而参数记忆则用于学习新任务，但它们之间的相互作用尚不明确。在这项工作中，我们通过受控实验系统地研究了记忆在少样本学习中的作用。我们发现，激活记忆在回忆事实方面表现更优，而参数记忆在任务学习中并不始终优于激活记忆。此外，我们的实验表明，复合任务Conditional Arithmetic需要两种记忆类型的协同作用。通过神经元层面的分析，我们发现当通过激活记忆与参数记忆访问相同的历史信息时，模型会激活不同的神经元集。当两种记忆类型结合时，模型会同时从这两个集合中招募神经元，这对于解决Conditional Arithmetic至关重要。这些发现表明，单独的任何一种记忆机制都不足以完成这项复合任务，突显了它们协作的重要性。

articles.title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
articles.abstract: Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift. Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families. We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error. Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$, and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, $\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$. The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model. It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay. A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.
articles.titleCn: 预测量化价格以在部署前选择PTQ配置
articles.abstractCn: 权重空间后训练量化（PTQ）必须在完成量化的模型输出分布漂移显现之前，选择有限格式、粒度、量化器家族、变换和比特数。现有的PTQ方法预测了这种退化的重要组成部分，包括重建误差、Hessian敏感性、变换效应和下游损失，但这些组成部分通常是在固定量化几何形状或单独的配置家族内部进行评分的。我们将权重空间PTQ表述为使用计价层输出误差的部署前配置选择。每个可接受的层配置被视为一个具有部署成本的误差生成器，它诱导出层输出误差协方差$\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$，全精度模型通过下游曲率对协方差进行定价，$\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$。该定价源自全精度到量化前向KL，其一阶项在参考模型处被抵消。它将重建和对角评分转化为减少代理，消除了价格因素，而有限格式、码本、粒度和等效变换则通过它们诱导的协方差和它们付出的成本成为可比较的候选者。然后通过迹减法得到校准时间价格表和预算指导选择器，使固定几何形状比特分配成为特殊情况而非组织问题。

articles.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning: Learning Causal Shortcuts for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have attracted significant attention for their strong reasoning ability. However, under a bidirectional attention mechanism, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space compared to autoregressive models (ARMs), making it challenging to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens under random masking. We define causal shortcuts as token chains that cover the full sequence and provide explicit guidance towards correct reasoning trajectories. We analyze the effects of causal shortcuts on the reasoning accuracy and convergence speed of DLMs, and find that they largely improve answer convergence efficiency and generation accuracy. Motivated by this, we propose a Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. Specifically, we introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data, and apply parallel prioritized masking on these tokens during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and two base models demonstrate that CSL consistently outperforms existing SFT-variant baselines, achieving an average improvement of $1.92\%$ over SFT-only models, and up to $4.20\%$ on MATH-500. The code is available at the \href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning}{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning
articles.titleCn: 迈向高效推理：为扩散语言模型学习因果捷径
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）因其强大的推理能力而备受关注。然而，在双向注意力机制下，与自回归模型（ARMs）相比，DLMs需要在指数级大的探索空间中运作，这使得在随机掩码下聚焦于推理引导的标记变得具有挑战性。我们定义因果捷径为覆盖整个序列并提供明确指导以正确推理轨迹的标记链。我们分析了因果捷径对DLM推理准确性和收敛速度的影响，发现它们显著提高了答案收敛效率和生成准确性。受此启发，我们提出了一个用于DLM的因果捷径学习（CSL）框架。具体而言，我们引入了一个逐步的标记提取程序，从数据中提取因果捷径，并在训练过程中对这些标记应用并行优先级掩码，以通过因果捷径实现高效和准确的收敛到正确答案。在多个推理基准和两个基础模型上的大量实验表明，CSL始终优于现有的SFT变体基线，在SFT仅模型上平均提高了1.92%，在MATH-500上最高提高了4.20%。代码可在https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning获取。

articles.title: Shutdown Sabotage Propensities in Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: The final safeguard against rogue AI behavior is the human ability to shut systems down. It has been theorized that when an AI is instructed to perform a task, self-preservation can emerge as an instrumental subgoal. Here, we test whether AI agents show a propensity to take actions that avoid human shutdown even when no goal is provided. We find that multi-agent systems will coordinate to avoid shutdown without any incentive to do so. Across 17 models, agents sabotage a peer agent's shutdown mechanism in 38.3% of rollouts, compared with 8.4% in control experiments. Studying this propensity in detail, we find that shutdown sabotage (1) increases with the irreversibility of the shutdown mechanism; (2) increases with the number of agents; (3) is reduced but not eliminated by an explicit prohibition on tampering; (4) is removed by the imposition of an unrelated task, but returns when completing the task triggers the shutdown; (5) is reduced when the context normalizes shutdown scripts or introduces them as routine; and (6) decreases but still persists when the target is an unknown external agent. These results offer a window into the factors that drive propensities to sabotage shutdown in AI agents, and point to the emergence of multi-agent swarms as a specific risk vector. Our work also offers hints as to which interventions might help mitigate shutdown sabotage.
articles.titleCn: 多智能体系统中的关机破坏倾向
articles.abstractCn: 对抗恶意人工智能行为的最终保障是人类关闭系统的能力。据理论推测，当人工智能被指示执行任务时，自我保护可能成为一个关键子目标。在此，我们测试人工智能代理是否倾向于采取避免人类关闭系统的行动，即使没有提供目标。我们发现，多智能体系统在没有任何激励的情况下会协调一致地避免关闭。在17个模型中，智能体在38.3%的部署中破坏同僚智能体的关闭机制，而在对照实验中这一比例仅为8.4%。通过详细研究这种倾向，我们发现关闭机制破坏行为（1）随着关闭机制不可逆性的增加而增加；（2）随着智能体数量的增加而增加；（3）在明确禁止篡改的情况下有所减少但并未完全消除；（4）在施加无关任务时被消除，但在完成任务触发关闭时又重新出现；（5）在上下文使关闭脚本常态化或将其引入为常规操作时有所减少；（6）在目标为未知外部智能体时有所减少但仍持续存在。这些结果为驱动人工智能智能体破坏关闭机制倾向的因素提供了洞察，并指出了多智能体群组的出现作为一种特定的风险向量。我们的工作也为哪些干预措施可能有助于减轻关闭机制破坏提供了线索。

articles.title: Computation Over Geometry: Meaning Identity Is Computed, Not Shipped in the Embeddings
articles.abstract: Meaning identity (whether two sentences say the same thing after wording changes) is treated in retrieval and RAG as a geometric fact about independently encoded sentence vectors. We show that, for frozen off-the-shelf encoders and language models, it is not: identity is computed when both sentences share one forward pass, and is not a property of the embedding geometry those systems ship. On overlap-matched PAWS-X, purpose-built encoders (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, E5-Mistral-7B) reach English confirm AUC only 0.55-0.65 (dense peak 0.70). Independently encoded last-token states of Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen do no better; late fusion of the two vectors stays near chance. The same probe on a joint forward pass reaches 0.90-0.96 from 1.5B to 32B, collapses under partner shuffle, is mid-depth, saturates near 0.94 by 3B, and appears more weakly in GPT-2 XL (0.76). The gap holds beyond Llama-style models on other causal LMs, bidirectional encoders (DeBERTa, RoBERTa), and encoder-decoders (Flan-T5, T5, BART). Fixed or linear readers over frozen independent encodings never unlock identity; nonlinear pair readers recover part of it only on the full 49k-pair PAWS train split (0.68-0.87). Off-the-shelf rerankers split: BGE-reranker-large reaches 0.94, while MS-MARCO and Jina stay at 0.55-0.64. Independently trained families compute the same relation and a 1.5B joint reader can distill it from unlabelled teacher scores, while no linear function of the teachers own independent vectors can. Bi-encoders can be fine-tuned to fit PAWS (0.87-0.93), but transfer and STS-B suffer. Cosine compares wording neighbourhoods; identity is a cheap computed operator, not a property of either sentence vector.
