articles.titleCn: 计算几何：意义同一性是在嵌入中被计算的，而不是被传输的
articles.abstractCn: 意义一致性（即两个句子在措辞变化后是否表达相同内容）在检索和RAG中被视为独立编码的句子向量之间的几何事实。我们证明，对于冻结的现成编码器和语言模型，事实并非如此：当两个句子共享一次前向传递时才会计算一致性，这并非这些系统所提供的嵌入几何属性的属性。在重叠匹配的PAWS-X上，专门设计的编码器（BGE、E5、GTE、MiniLM、E5-Mistral-7B）仅达到英语确认AUC 0.55-0.65（密集峰值0.70）。Llama 3、Mistral和Qwen独立编码的最后一个token状态表现同样不佳；两个向量的后期融合仍接近随机水平。在联合前向传递上的同一探测达到1.5B至32B的0.90-0.96，但在伙伴打乱时崩溃，处于中等深度，在3B时接近0.94饱和，并在GPT-2 XL中较弱（0.76）。这种差距在其他因果语言模型、双向编码器（DeBERTa、RoBERTa）和编码器-解码器（Flan-T5、T5、BART）上依然存在。固定或线性读取器在冻结的独立编码上从未解锁一致性；非线性对读取器仅在完整的49k对PAWS训练集上（0.68-0.87）部分恢复它。现成重排序器表现不一：BGE-reranker-large达到0.94，而MS-MARCO和Jina仍保持在0.55-0.64。独立训练的家族计算相同关系，1.5B的联合读取器可以从无标签教师分数中提取它，而教师独立向量的任何线性函数都无法做到。双编码器可以微调以适应PAWS（0.87-0.93），但迁移和STS-B受损。余弦比较措辞邻域；一致性是一个廉价的计算算子，不是句子向量的属性。

articles.title: Mizar: A 159M-Parameter Audio-Language Model for Audio Understanding
articles.abstract: Audio-language models (ALMs) integrate acoustic perception with the knowledge encoded in language models, enabling contextual understanding of auditory events. Making these capabilities practical on devices with limited memory and computation motivates our focus on small ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters. We introduce a recipe that brings together architecture, data, and three-stage training to build Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter ALM. Its architecture connects a compact CED-Small audio encoder to SmolLM2-135M through a frequency-merging mapper. With supervision drawn from ReasonAQA, AudioMCQ, and AVQA, the model undergoes three training stages: audio-language alignment (Stage 1), audio-dependent fine-tuning (Stage 2), and post-training (Stage 3) aimed at strengthening weak skills while retaining learned capabilities. Across five random seeds, Mizar achieves mean accuracies of 52.92% on MMAU, 42.42% on MMAR, and 36.02% on ADQA-clean, surpassing the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters on all three benchmarks. It also supports local inference on a single CPU: on questions from the MMAU benchmark, the mean latency from opening the audio file to generating a complete answer is 1.09 seconds. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M.
articles.titleCn: Mizar：一个用于音频理解的1.59亿参数音频语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 音频语言模型（ALM）将声学感知与语言模型中编码的知识相结合，从而实现对听觉事件上下文的理解。在内存和计算资源有限的设备上实现这些功能，促使我们专注于参数少于2亿的小型ALM。我们介绍了一种将架构、数据和三阶段训练相结合的方法，以构建Mizar，一个1.593亿参数的ALM。其架构通过频率合并映射器将紧凑型CED-Small音频编码器连接到SmolLM2-135M。在ReasonAQA、AudioMCQ和AVQA的监督下，模型经历了三个训练阶段：音频-语言对齐（第一阶段）、音频相关微调（第二阶段）以及旨在强化薄弱技能同时保留已学能力的第三阶段训练。在五个随机种子下，Mizar在MMAU上达到52.92%的平均准确率，在MMAR上达到42.42%，在ADQA-clean上达到36.02%，在所有三个基准测试中均超越了参数少于2亿的最佳ALM。它还支持单CPU上的本地推理：在MMAU基准测试的问题中，从打开音频文件到生成完整答案的平均延迟为1.09秒。代码和检查点可在https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M获取。

articles.title: Digital diglossia: Arabic between X and Facebook
articles.abstract: This study highlights the distribution of Standard Arabic (SA; H(igh) variety) and Colloquial Arabic (CA; L(ow) variety) across X and Facebook. 16754 public posts were collected via Python, with 10000 retained as the net dataset. Posts were classified into 7 discourse categories: *politics, technology, science, business, culture, fun,* and *sports*. Bivariate analyses, including Chi-square tests and Cramer's V (CV), examined associations among platform, discourse category, and diglossic choice, while binary logistic regression with Platform x Discourse Category interactions tested whether these associations varied across platforms. Findings reveal that there are significant associations between discourse category and diglossic choice on X, chi-square(6, *N* = 5000) = 600.35, p < .001, CV = .347, and Facebook, chi-square(6, N = 5000) = 1249.52, p < .001, CV = .500. Across platforms, platform was also associated with diglossic choice, chi-square(1, N = 10000) = 262.16, p < .001, CV = .162. Binary logistic regression further shows higher odds of SA use on X than Facebook in the political reference category (*OR* = 1.31, p = .0028), with significant platform-by-domain interactions for Culture (OR = 2.65), Fun (*OR* = 6.34), Sports (*OR* = 26.71), Science (OR = 0.41), and Technology (OR = 0.71). The study concludes that the diglossic use of SA and CA contributes to the growing body of research on digital discourse, unveiling that the digital age reshapes but does not erode diglossic boundaries, giving rise instead to a reconfigured digital diglossia.
articles.titleCn: 数字双语现象：阿拉伯语在X和Facebook之间
articles.abstractCn: 本研究突出了标准阿拉伯语（SA；高变体）和口语阿拉伯语（CA；低变体）在推特和Facebook上的分布情况。通过Python收集了16754条公开帖子，其中10000条被保留为净数据集。帖子被分为七个话语类别：*政治、科技、科学、商业、文化、娱乐*和*体育*。双变量分析，包括卡方检验和克莱姆V系数（CV），考察了平台、话语类别和双语选择之间的关联，而二元逻辑回归结合平台x话语类别交互作用则检验了这些关联是否因平台而异。研究发现，在推特和Facebook上，话语类别与双语选择之间存在显著关联：推特，卡方（6，*N*=5000）=600.35，p<.001，CV=0.347；Facebook，卡方（6，N=5000）=1249.52，p<.001，CV=0.500。在所有平台上，平台也与双语选择相关，卡方（1，N=10000）=262.16，p<.001，CV=0.162。二元逻辑回归进一步显示，在政治话语类别中，推特的SA使用几率高于Facebook（*OR*=1.31，p=.0028），并且文化（*OR*=2.65）、娱乐（*OR*=6.34）、体育（*OR*=26.71）、科学（*OR*=0.41）和科技（*OR*=0.71）存在显著的平台-领域交互作用。研究结论表明，SA和CA的双语使用促进了数字话语研究的发展，揭示了数字时代重塑而非侵蚀双语边界，反而催生了重新配置的数字双语现象。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Translation: General Forgetting Mitigation Does Not Preserve MT-Specific Instruction Following
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting. Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks. We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF): instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control. We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data. Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning. Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.
articles.titleCn: 为翻译而微调大型语言模型：通用遗忘缓解方法并不能保持机器翻译特定的指令遵循能力
articles.abstractCn: 在平行数据上微调大型语言模型可以提高翻译质量，但可能导致灾难性遗忘。缓解方法通常通过在通用基准上的保留效果进行评估。我们探究这些发现是否适用于机器翻译（MT）微调和MT特定指令遵循（MT-IF）：例如修改翻译的指令，如正式程度、语法性别和长度控制。我们比较了基于辅助数据、模型输出和基础模型参数的方法，首先在Llama 3.2 1B Instruct的筛选研究中，然后在在双向阿拉伯语-英语或西班牙语-英语数据上微调的Llama 3.1 8B Instruct上。弹性权重整合在两个阶段中都最佳地保留了通用能力；在8B西班牙语模型上，标准微调的平均得分下降了11.0分，而弹性权重整合仅下降了1.7分，其正式程度和语法性别控制的得分仍接近标准微调。只有与控制任务示例混合的数据能保留这些控制，但其收益并未转移到同一任务中未见过的提示上。

articles.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from \emph{task-state contamination}, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort subsequent decisions. We propose the \textbf{Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)}, which models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress rather than simulating tool responses. AEWM combines \textbf{Action Judge} to distinguish \textsc{Critical}, \textsc{Exploratory}, and \textsc{Noisy} decisions with \textbf{State Revision} to edit noisy reasoning--action continuations from the same observed history. \textbf{EditAct} integrates these capabilities with real execution, directly changing the state underlying subsequent decisions rather than merely providing critiques. We train AEWM across Search, Terminal, and Software Engineering through mid-training and supervised fine-tuning. AEWM achieves 70.5\% macro-F1 on our Action Judge benchmark, exceeding the strongest frontier baseline by 10.6 points. Across six benchmarks and three agent backbones, EditAct improves average scores by 3.2--6.7 points over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, rejection sampling fine-tuning on verified EditAct trajectories, termed \textbf{AEWM-RFT}, improves over Self-RFT by 2.2--2.6 points across three domains without online AEWM guidance.
articles.titleCn: 代理编辑世界模型：重新思考用于大型语言模型代理的世界建模
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使智能体能够在不同环境中处理长时程任务。为了进一步提升智能体性能，现有的语言世界模型通常预测环境观测结果，但在真实反馈可用时，重建高熵、执行依赖的工具响应所能提供的价值有限。与此同时，智能体受到任务状态污染的影响，其中不受支持的假设和过时的计划会持续存在于历史记录中，并扭曲后续决策。我们提出了**智能体编辑世界模型（AEWM）**，该模型模拟推理和行动如何塑造未来任务进展，而非模拟工具响应。AEWM结合了**行动判断器**来区分**关键**、**探索性**和**噪声**决策，以及**状态修订**来编辑来自同一观测历史的噪声推理-行动连续体。**EditAct**将这些能力与真实执行相结合，直接改变后续决策所依赖的状态，而非仅仅提供批评。我们通过中期训练和监督微调，在搜索、终端和软件工程领域训练AEWM。在行动判断器基准测试中，AEWM达到了70.5%的宏观F1值，比最强的前沿基线高出10.6个百分点。在六个基准测试和三种智能体主干网络中，EditAct比最强基线平均提升了3.2至6.7个百分点。此外，在经过验证的EditAct轨迹上进行拒绝采样微调，称为**AEWM-RFT**，在三个领域内比Self-RFT提升了2.2至2.6个百分点，且无需在线AEWM指导。

articles.title: Cross-Scale Transfer Learning for Depression Severity Prediction: From PHQ-8 to HAMD-17 Across Languages and Clinical Paradigms
articles.abstract: This work addresses continuous depression-severity score prediction from clinical interview transcripts under data scarcity. We propose a sequential low-rank adaptation (LoRA) protocol for cross-scale transfer: a Qwen3 backbone with a bounded regression head is first fine-tuned on the English DAIC-WOZ dataset (189 avatar-mediated sessions, PHQ-8), and the adapter then initializes fine-tuning on the Chinese PDCH dataset (100 real clinical consultations, HAMD-17), where a reinitialised, scale-specific head predicts the clinician-assigned score. All configurations use patient-level stratified 5-fold, 2-repeat cross-validation. On the data-scarce HAMD-17 target, the sequential protocol attains the best point-estimate MAE , RMSE, and macro-$F_1$ on both 0.6B and 1.7B backbones, outperforming target-only training and non-LLM baselines---4.96/6.59/0.36 with Qwen3-0.6B and 4.38/5.62/0.46 with Qwen3-1.7B. Ablations suggest that correctly aligned source supervision gives the best point estimates (unsupervised exposure and shuffled-label controls also show partial gains), that native-Chinese target input outperforms machine-translated English input, and that the reversed order yields no clear gain within run-to-run variance. The study is an exploratory, single-site internal evaluation: it does not establish screening or diagnostic utility, nor separately identify the contribution of the scale, language, or paradigm shifts. To our knowledge, no prior study evaluates this specific DAIC-WOZ-to-PDCH sequential transfer setting.
articles.titleCn: 跨尺度迁移学习在抑郁症严重程度预测中的应用：从PHQ-8到HAMD-17，跨越语言和临床范式
articles.abstractCn: 这项工作旨在解决在数据稀缺情况下，从临床访谈记录中进行持续抑郁严重程度评分预测的问题。我们提出了一种跨尺度迁移的顺序低秩适配（LoRA）协议：首先在英语DAIC-WOZ数据集（189个由虚拟化身进行的会话，使用PHQ-8量表）上对带有有界回归头的Qwen3主干进行微调，然后适配器在中文PDCH数据集（100次真实临床咨询，使用HAMD-17量表）上初始化微调，其中重新初始化的特定尺度头预测临床医生分配的评分。所有配置均使用基于患者的分层5折2重复交叉验证。在数据稀缺的HAMD-17目标集上，顺序协议在0.6B和1.7B主干上均获得了最佳点估计MAE、RMSE和宏观F1，优于仅目标训练和非LLM基线——使用Qwen3-0.6B时为4.96/6.59/0.36，使用Qwen3-1.7B时为4.38/5.62/0.46。消融实验表明，正确对齐的源监督提供了最佳点估计（无监督暴露和打乱标签的控制也显示出部分增益），母语中文的目标输入优于机器翻译的英语输入，而反向顺序在运行间方差内没有明显增益。这项研究是一次探索性的单中心内部评估：它没有确立筛查或诊断效用，也没有分别识别尺度、语言或范式转变的贡献。据我们所知，没有先前研究评估过这种特定的DAIC-WOZ到PDCH顺序迁移设置。

articles.title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reordering a set of mathematical rules without changing its meaning should preserve the correct answer, but must a model's internal representations stay invariant too? We investigate this question using synthetic multi-step function-composition problems, each presented under multiple rule orderings with the same correct answer. We measure accuracy and permutation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which quantifies how distinctly ordering patterns are represented relative to variation across problem instances. Across 16 language models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters, we find a pattern: models that solve reordered problems more accurately represent different rule orderings more distinctly. Layer-averaged permutation SNR is positively rank-correlated with accuracy in every synthetic setting we evaluate, with Spearman correlations reaching 0.86. These findings highlight a distinction between answer invariance and representation invariance: successful mathematical rule composition can accompany distinct internal representations between equivalent rule orderings. This motivates distinguishing answer invariance from representation invariance, and offers a representational perspective on mathematical reasoning beyond answer accuracy alone.
articles.titleCn: 数学推理中的顺序不变答案与顺序敏感表示
articles.abstractCn: 在不改变其含义的情况下重新排序一组数学规则应当保持正确的答案，但模型的内部表示是否也必须保持不变？我们通过合成多步函数复合问题来研究这个问题，每个问题都呈现多种规则排序，但具有相同的正确答案。我们测量了准确性和排列信噪比（SNR），后者量化了排序模式相对于问题实例变化的独特表示程度。在16个参数量从1B到8B的语言模型中，我们发现了一个规律：那些更准确解决重新排序问题的模型，更能清晰地区分不同的规则排序。在所有我们评估的合成环境中，层平均排列SNR与准确性呈正相关，Spearman相关系数高达0.86。这些发现突显了答案不变性与表示不变性之间的区别：成功的数学规则组合可以伴随着等价规则排序之间的不同内部表示。这促使我们将答案不变性与表示不变性区分开来，并从表示的角度提供了超越仅关注答案准确性的数学推理视角。

articles.title: Can LLMs Reason About Runtime Behavior? A Repository-Level Dynamic Benchmark
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in coding tasks, but their ability to reason about code execution remains unclear. Existing repository-level QA benchmarks mainly evaluate static code understanding and often rely on LLM-based evaluation, while execution-reasoning benchmarks are mostly limited to snippets or functions. We introduce SWE-Flux, a repository-level benchmark for dynamic execution reasoning containing 480 execution-grounded instances across 12 real Python repositories, with gold answers automatically harvested from instrumented test executions rather than written manually or judged by LLMs. The benchmark covers singletest and multi-test questions over control flow, loops, program state, dataflow, exceptions, and program invariants. Evaluating five LLMs shows that this task remains challenging. The best model achieves only 37% accuracy. Models perform better on localized behavior such as invariants, intra-procedural control flow, exceptions, and simple loops, but struggle with dataflow, inter-procedural execution, precise state reasoning, and suite-level aggregation. Finally, we show that the oracle-harvesting pipeline can generate fresh benchmark variants using input perturbation. It successfully harvests valid variants for almost 90% of the selected instances, and the resulting variants are substantially more challenging for the evaluated models.
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否推理运行时行为？一个基于库级别的动态基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在编程任务中应用日益广泛，但其对代码执行进行推理的能力尚不明确。现有的代码库级问答基准主要评估静态代码理解，且常依赖基于LLMs的评估，而执行推理基准大多局限于代码片段或函数。我们引入了SWE-Flux，这是一个包含动态执行推理的代码库级基准，涵盖12个真实Python代码库中的480个基于执行的实例，其标准答案通过在测试执行中自动收集而非手动编写或由LLMs判定获得。该基准覆盖了控制流、循环、程序状态、数据流、异常和程序不变量等方面的单测试和多测试问题。评估五个LLMs表明，该任务仍具挑战性，最佳模型的准确率仅为37%。模型在不变量、过程内控制流、异常和简单循环等局部行为上表现较好，但在数据流、过程间执行、精确状态推理和套件级聚合方面表现不佳。最后，我们展示了预言机收集流程可以通过输入扰动生成新的基准变体。该流程成功为近90%的选定实例收集到有效的变体，且这些变体对评估模型构成了显著更大的挑战。

articles.title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification
articles.abstract: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.

articles.titleCn: 对比学习用于作者身份验证
articles.abstractCn: 我们的结果表明，在测试设置下，对比学习方法在作者身份验证方面优于基于分类的方法。我们确定了损失函数、批处理大小、训练时长、预训练模型、输入上下文长度以及随机文本跨度数据增强为模型性能的重要因素。基于这些考虑，我们开发了一个ModernBERT双编码器模型，在PAN21作者身份验证任务上达到了98.4%的准确率。
